articleTitle: Electrical Fault Detection And Localization Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Electrical faults pose significant challenges in power systems, often leading to operational disruptions and safety concerns. Timely detection and localization of these faults are crucial for ensuring uninterrupted power supply and preventing potential hazards. In this context, machine learning techniques have emerged as promising tools for enhancing fault diagnosis systems. This study presents a comprehensive approach to electrical fault detection and localization, leveraging machine learning algorithms. Drawing inspiration from real-world scenarios, such as power grid failures and industrial equipment malfunctions, we address the pressing need for reliable fault detection methods. The proposed methodology focuses on the utilization of decision tree classifier and contrasts its performance with the random forest algorithm. Through preprocessing steps, including feature engineering and normalization, the data is prepared for training. Additionally, this study addresses the issue of imbalanced classes by employing the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), which enhances the robustness of our analysis. Using a diverse dataset encompassing various fault types, we conduct extensive experimentation and evaluation. Our results demonstrate the superiority of decision tree-based methodologies in achieving high accuracy rates in fault detection and localization tasks. By presenting practical insights and performance metrics, this research contributes to the ongoing discourse in the field of electrical engineering. Overall, this study not only highlights the effectiveness of machine learning approaches in fault diagnosis but also underscores their potential for real-world implementation in power systems and industrial settings. These findings hold significant implications for engineers and practitioners seeking reliable solutions for mitigating electrical faults and ensuring operational resilience.

articleTitle: Facial Expression based Music Recommendation System using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The proposed context-aware music recommendation system revolutionizes user experience by combining cutting-edge face recognition technology with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms. To overcome the challenges faced by traditional voice analysis methodologies, this research study not only enhances mood detection accuracy but also significantly reduces the training duration. Utilizing the Streamlit library for the user interface ensures seamless interaction across various expertise levels. In the backend, the synergy among TensorFlow, Keras API, and foundational frameworks like NumPy empowers the proposed system to efficiently analyze extensive datasets, delivering personalized music recommendations in real-time. This integration of face recognition, CNN algorithms, and robust frameworks signifies a technological leap, reshaping the music recommendation landscape by acknowledging the dynamic nature of emotions and the diverse contexts in which users engage with music.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Continuous Glucose Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: With the prevalence of diabetes and its associated health complications, precise glucose level assessment through routine testing is imperative for effective disease management and mitigation of adverse outcomes. Internet of Things (IoT) based Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) System, represents an innovative medical device for enabling real-time blood glucose management among individuals suffering with diabetes, a metabolic disorder characterized by abnormal and unregulated blood glucose levels. With the increasing popularity of non-invasive diagnostic techniques, this study proposes an IoT-enabled device capable of reliably measuring blood sugar levels. The results show the successful real-time implementation of the proposed CGM model.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Prediction and Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research addresses the challenges in the early identification of lung cancer by proposing an automated system using various Machine Learning (ML) and image processing techniques. This study has utilized a collection of images including different lung cancer types and healthy lung tissue. By analyzing this data, deep understanding has gained on its properties. Then, this study has tested various machine learning models and selected the most accurate one for real-time implementation. The proposed system's effectiveness in lung cancer detection is finally analyzed by using performance evaluation. Finally, the system is deployed with a user-friendly interface to aid healthcare professionals in diagnosing lung cancer.

articleTitle: Help the Deaf and Mute: A Mobile-Assisted App for Quick Emergency Reporting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The World Health Organization (WHO) puts on record that five per cent of the world population (430 million people) constitute the mute and deaf, and this number has increased exponentially over the years. This population, Omani included, is facing social, behavioral, and psychological challenges that extend to communication and safety concerns. It is an ongoing concern among these populations that they have difficulty asking for immediate assistance during emergencies due to their inherent limitation of communication. This study aims to provide an image-based messaging template for quick emergency reporting for the Royal Oman Police targeting respondents in Muscat using Android mobile phones. Using the Google Fuse location provider, the app keeps track of the current location of the user. With the built-in help templates, the app enables the users to send emergency and the current location using SMS. Also, they can use other messaging apps on the phone to send messages via the internet and create customized messages for quick access. The app garnered “very satisfied” evaluation in the following areas: (1) Templates for quick creation of emergency messages; (2) Customization of emergency messages; (3) Quick sending of location; (4) Effectiveness of visual images; and (5) Alternative options to send message. Overall, the respondents strongly signified that the proposed app is better than the currently used one. For future work, the app should include image and video attachments as the proposed app is purely based on SMS messaging.

articleTitle: Efficient Video Streaming on Raspberry Pi 4B: Reducing CPU Utilization Through Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Live video streaming on resource-constrained platforms like Raspberry Pi 4B (RPi-4B) requires balancing quality with computational efficiency. This research investigates the effectiveness of FFMPEG pipeline optimization techniques in minimizing the CPU utilization during live video streaming from the RPi-4B camera. Presenting a comprehensive analysis of CPU usage across different frame rates, resolutions, and encoding configurations through extensive experimentation. Furthermore, demonstrating the efficacy of fine-grained FFMPEG parameter optimization in further reducing CPU pressure while maintaining acceptable video quality. This research can provides valuable insights for developers and researchers seeking to implement efficient live video streaming applications on RPi-4B. Leveraging the capabilities of FFMPEG and the optimization techniques presented here, this work paves the way for resource-efficient streaming solutions tailored for resource-constrained environments.

Author Keywords: Fast Forward Moving Picture Experts Group (FFMPEG)

articleTitle: Light Weight CNN Based on Knowledge Distillation for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a severe consequence of diabetes, which poses a significant threat to vision, potentially leading to irreversible blindness if not diagnosed in its early stages. It generally impacts 80% of people, who have had diabetes for more than ten years. This condition arises from diabetes-induced damage to retinal blood vessels, emphasizing the critical need for precise and timely intervention and diagnosis. Traditional screening methods depend on the manual examination of colored fundus images by trained specialists; there are chances of errors that might miss the early signs of diabetic retinopathy. Various Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) such as DenseNet121, DenseNet169, DenseNet201, MobileNet, ResNet152, Xception, and Inception are explored to address this challenge. It is engaged with these models through rigorous experimentation to examine their capabilities to enhance the precision of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) diagnosis in all its stages. Though these models give efficient accuracies, the size of these models makes it complex to be embedded in miniature medical devices. This study has introduced the application of knowledge distillation through implementing the teacher-student model. This research study aims to achieve a lighter, more compact, and simpler student model, which is derived from the more complex teacher model, which, in this case, is the aforementioned model. After thorough analysis, this study found that the student model mentored by the DenseNet169 outperforms other models in accurately detecting Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) with the highest validation accuracy of 68. 77%. Using a diverse dataset from Kaggle, our focus goes beyond improving accuracy. This study aims to contribute valuable insights to fight against diabetes complication.

articleTitle: Stress Detection During Social Interactions with Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The field of Natural Language Processing (NLP) is witnessing a growing recognition of the significance of investigating stress-related phenomena. This research study proposes a new framework to address the diagnostic challenges associated with mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, and stress, which can worsen if left unaddressed. Within this research study, social media postings and comments are used to enhance sentiment and emotion analysis for assessing individuals' stress levels. Specifically, text analysis of social media data, including Twitter tweets, serves as a pivotal application. The proposed system is implemented by employing a combination of Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning (DL) methodologies. The proposed system utilizes Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), BERT transfer learning techniques, as well as Machine Learning (ML) algorithms such as Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). This study aims to predict five distinct emotional categories: “Happy, ” “Angry, ” “Depression, ” “Sad, ” and “Fear.” Remarkably, the proposed system has achieved an accuracy and F1 score exceeding 93%, outperforming the performance of other existing human emotion recognition systems.

articleTitle: Predicting the Fake Review to Amazon Product Review Dataset Using Fuzzy Optimized Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: E-commerce product reviews have become crucial for online users in making purchase decisions, particularly on platforms like Amazon and Flipkart, where user interactions and feedback are highly emphasized. Recently, sentiment analysis is employed to assess user opinions on products by extracting valuable insights regarding various features and benefits. These reviews are widely distributed to leverage and disseminate user perspectives, providing valuable information on user sentiments in comment sections to differentiate positive and negative feedback. With the proliferation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, detecting fake reviews has become imperative to ensure the authenticity of user opinions. To address this, a fuzzy-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed to differentiate genuine and fake product reviews based on user opinions and their review across similar products. The proposed architecture is designed to be resilient to temporal changes in user behavior. Initially, data preprocessing is performed to obtain user profile and product characteristics and parse statements. The preprocessed data is then subjected to Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to extract features representing user intentions. These features are given as input to the fuzzy-based CNN to analyze user behavior across various aspects. The obtained optimal behavioral data is utilized to train the fuzzy-optimized CNN, which provide valuable predictions on changes in user opinion towards different products. The proposed architecture employs convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected networks for review classification and fake review prediction. Performance evaluation on an Amazon product review dataset demonstrates superior performance in terms of precision, recall, accuracy, and F-measure compared to conventional architectures.

articleTitle: Vehicle Forecasting: A Machine Learning Approach for Predicting and Preventing Vehicle Issues, Based on the Design Thinking Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Bus location tracking systems are sophisticated technological systems that have revolutionized public transportation. These systems use advanced technologies, such as Global Positioning System (GPS) and wireless communication, to monitor and manage bus fleets in real-time. GPS receivers installed on buses provide precise location data, while communication networks facilitate data transmission to a central server. This data is then processed, analyzed, and made accessible through various platforms, including mobile applications and web interfaces. These systems have found wide-ranging applications in both developed and developing urban environments. Transit agencies utilize these systems to optimize routes, manage schedules, and proactively respond to incidents and disruptions. Bus location tracking systems have become a powerful toolset for transit agencies to refine bus routes, optimize schedules, and elevate the overall operational efficiency of public transit networks. The core components of bus location tracking systems include GPS devices installed on buses, a central server or cloud-based platform for data processing, and user interfaces accessible through mobile apps, websites, and display screens at bus stations. These user interfaces provide passengers with a user-friendly experience to track buses, estimate arrival times, and plan their journeys seamlessly.

articleTitle: Multi-Model Supervised Machine Learning Techniques for Heart Stroke Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research presents a supervised machine learning approach for heart attack prediction using several models. Prompt care and preventative measures may be possible with early recognition of heart attacks, which pose a significant danger to health. This study proposes a new method that integrates the strengths of many machine learning models to improve the precision of the generated predictions. Blood pressure, cholesterol levels, age, gender, medical history, and other risk indicators are all part of the study's dataset. The dataset is preprocessed for learning the missing values and standardizing the features. Three separate ML algorithms-logistic regression, random forest, and support vector classifier (SVC)-are then trained by using the preprocessed data. The prediction ability is enhanced by stacking using the differences between each model. Then, performance metrics, including F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision are used to evaluate the stacked model. The results of the experiments demonstrate that the multi-model approach outperforms the individual models, leading to more reliable and precise predictions. The proposed technique shows the potential to predict heart attacks and assist doctors in identifying people at high risk of experiencing a heart stroke.

articleTitle: The Role of Machine Learning in Crime Analysis and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Crime prediction has become essential in modern law enforcement for enabling proactive strategies to enhance public safety. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, particularly Random Forest, offer a powerful tool for analyzing extensive datasets and uncovering complex patterns. Random Forest's ensemble learning approach is well-suited for managing high-dimensional data and capturing nonlinear relationships. This study provides an in-depth examination of crime prediction with Random Forest, emphasizing its advantages such as feature selection, robustness to noise, and scalability. Theoretical foundations, including bagging learning and decision tree aggregation, are explored, showcasing Random Forest's predictive capabilities. Empirical studies and real-world applications demonstrate its effectiveness across various spatial and temporal scales. Integrating Random Forest-based crime prediction systems into law enforcement practices enables agencies to anticipate trends, allocate resources strategically, and implement targeted interventions for community safety. By leveraging data-driven approaches, law enforcement can effectively address and mitigate criminal activities, contributing to safer communities.

articleTitle: Sensor Enabled Smart Wearable for Hazard Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Coal mining safety has been a longstanding concern, underscored by the alarming toll of worker fatalities. The hazardous nature of coal mining operations exposes workers to multiple risks, including carbon monoxide exposure and temperature fluctuations. To overcome these challenges, this study has developed a new model powered by an ESP8266 and sensors such as a gas detector, temperature sensor, and accelerometer. The proposed model proactively prioritizes worker wellbeing by identifying risks such as carbon monoxide, environmental changes, and fall detection. The developed device also includes a responsive buzzer and Telegram update to the user's mobile, ensuring a rapid emergency action. Verilog code has been methodically created for future FPGA deployment; it is now used as a preliminary step. The code's strategic design predicts optimal sensor data processing and takes advantage of the parallel processing capabilities inherent in FPGA architecture, resulting in faster real-time responses.

articleTitle: Cloud-based Data Protection: A Framework for Authorizing Data Movement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: As organizations increasingly migrate their data operations to cloud environments and harness the power of big data analytics, ensuring the security and privacy of data in motion becomes paramount. This research study outlines a comprehensive cloud authorisation framework explicitly designed to address the unique challenges posed by the dynamic nature of big data processing in cloud environments. The proposed prototype / framework integrates advanced authentication and authorisation mechanisms tailored to the characteristics of big data systems, including distributed processing, heterogeneous data sources, and diverse user access patterns. Leveraging scalable cloud infrastructure and advanced cryptographic techniques, the framework ensures granular access control and data protection throughout the data lifecycle. Designing a comprehensive Cloud Authorization Framework for Data in Motion within Big Data entails addressing numerous key components and considerations. A broad framework design is shown in this research study. It includes mechanisms for authentication and authorisation, multi-tenancy management, continuous monitoring and remediation, working with third-party providers, educating and raising awareness among users. By integrating these components, organisations can establish a robust security infrastructure capable of safeguarding sensitive data in cloud environments.

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Heartbeat Detector for Data Assisted Smart Elderly Care System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Addressing the persistent challenge of effectively monitoring the safety of the elderly within enclosed spaces, this research introduces a novel solution: The dynamic heartbeat detector for data-assisted smart elderly care system. This innovative model comprises three key components: Firstly, a novel Dynamic Heartbeat Detector is engineered to capture efficient heart signal data. Secondly, a robust signal wireless transmission algorithm is devised to seamlessly relay detector signals to the information hub. Lastly, an innovative abnormal data identification algorithm is introduced to forecast heart risks, facilitating the construction of the Data-Assisted Smart Elderly Care System. Validation of the model's performance involved the collection of four seasonal datasets, yielding an average accuracy rate of 96% and demonstrating its efficacy in effectively predicting risks for the elderly. This research marks a significant advancement in ensuring the safety and well-being of the elderly population within enclosed environments, offering a promising opportunity for the development of smarter, data-driven elderly care systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Kyphosis Disease Prediction: Evaluating Machine Learning Algorithms Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Kyphosis, characterized by the inward arching of the upper back, is often colloquially referred to as “roundback” or “hunchback” when a noticeable curvature is present. This condition typically arises due to weakened spinal bones, leading to compression or fractures. In children or adolescents, other forms of kyphosis may be attributed to spinal abnormalities or a progressive twisting of the spinal bones. While kyphosis can manifest at any age, it is most prevalent in teenagers. Multiple factors, ranging from poor posture and developmental issues to structural abnormalities in the spine, can contribute to its occurrence. This research introduces a machine learning approach aimed at predicting kyphosis disease, with a focus on enhancing early detection and improving patient outcomes. This research intends to incorporate different machine-learning approaches to biological data, such as Decision Trees and Random Forests, evaluate and assess the granularity of these algorithms. The findings underscore the significance of machine learning (ML) as a valuable tool for addressing biological problems in a broader context.

articleTitle: Enhancing Underwater Acoustic Noise Reduction Method With Advanced Noise Reduction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Underwater acoustic classification is a challenging task due to substantial ambient noises and complicated sound transfer pathways in the aquatic environment. This neccsites the need for noise elimination in subsurface acoustic signal handling. Due to the challenges faced by marine ecosystem and unique characteristics of undersea acoustic channels, suppression of undersea acoustical waves remains an important task in the area of aquatic acoustical signal manipulation. The proposed approach provides a remedy for reducing noise by utilizing the LMS filter in the initial phase and the RLS filter in the subsequent phase, which aids in the extraction of noises and signalling features for classification via ANIFS systems. The proposed approach incorporates noise mitigation and categorization, which may enhance the system's predictive reliability over 95% with a Root Mean Square (RMS) score of 0.7. As a result, the suggested approach outperforms other methods for noise suppression and classifications.

articleTitle: Electronic Medical Images Security and Privacy Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The Internet of Medical Things has gained focus in recent years. To protect medical data being generated and transmitted securely without third-party intervention over shared insecure channels. This work focuses on the current state of security and privacy techniques being used by researchers. The study shows that alterations were made to the medical data or images before being hidden. Which creates a problem when they are referred to in the future for medical diagnosis. The work also incorporates the popular performance evaluation parameters that are used for ensuring the security and privacy of Electronic Medical Images (EMI). The validity of the studied methods was judged with the help of various performance evaluation test such as Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Mean Square Error (MSE), Structural Similarity Index Metrics (SSIM), etc. Most of the reviewed papers were able to achieve preferred values thus a good PSNR, low MSE, while SSIM value is close to 1 indicating similarity between the original image and extracted image.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Safety Through IoT-Integrated Smart Helmet Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The smart helmet's characteristics are meant to identify and report whether or not a wearer has consumed alcohol while donning a helmet. Road accidents are increasing as a result of riders drinking alcohol and not wearing helmets. In the modern world, thousands of people lose their lives in auto accidents each year. Wearing a smart helmet can typically lower the number of accidents. The primary objective of this research study is to create a wearable helmet that can both detect alcohol and prevent accidents without the need for a helmet. Whether the user is wearing a helmet is determined by the limit switch. The rider's breath is tested by the Gas sensor to determine whether alcohol is present. If the rider has ingested alcohol or is not wearing a helmet, the bike will not start. Only when a helmet is on and there are no indications of intoxication can the bike be started. System construction is done by sensor actions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Network Traffic Reduction for Optimal Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In response to the increasing demands of network traffic, this research study presents an Adaptive Network Traffic Reduction system to dynamically manage network resources for optimal performance. Unlike utilizing P4 and IoT devices, this system harnesses the versatility of Java programming language. By leveraging Java, this system facilitates real-time analysis and manipulation of network traffic, ensuring efficient traffic management without the need for specialized hardware. Through intelligent traffic monitoring, analysis, and adaptive traffic shaping techniques, this system optimizes network utilization, alleviates congestion, and enhances overall network performance. This adaptive approach enables this systemto respond dynamically to changing network conditions, mitigating traffic bottlenecks in dynamic environments. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the effectiveness of this approach, demonstrating its ability to adapt to varying network conditions and ensure smooth traffic flow. By utilizing Java-based programming, adaptive traffic management strategies and AES algorithm which encrypts and decrypts data using a block cipher technique to ensure confidentiality and security in digital communications and storage.

articleTitle: A Unified Framework for Recommend Medicine Review Categories Through Bi-LSTM and Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The number of users and daily tweets on Twitter are significant. The medicine review categories system is designed to leverage the vast amount of patient-generated data to create a reliable and effective medication recommendation framework. The proposed system employs Deep Learning and Machine Learning techniques, specifically utilizing a deep learning technology known as Bi-Directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) and machine learning algorithms Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes to evaluate textual data effectively. The primary objective of our system is to identify appropriate categories of input text /review based on patient reviews and defined categories in the dataset. In the dataset, we found two columns where one is a review and another is categories like treatment and medication, prevention, symptoms causes, news, and others where we will find the exact categories of our input review. We evaluate the system's performance using various metrics, including Fl Score, precision, recall, and accuracy, ensuring its robustness and efficacy. Bi LSTM models provided an accuracy of 95%, the Decision Tree models provided an accuracy of 94 %., the Random Forest models resulted in an accuracy of 92%., and the Naive Bayes models provided an accuracy of 84%. This comprehensive approach aims to provide medical experts with a reliable tool for predicting and ultimately contributing to more informed and personalized healthcare decisions.

articleTitle: An Effective Model based on CNN - LSTM for E-Commerce Product Title Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The number of products posted by sellers on each e-commerce system is often very large, up to millions of products and can be many millions of times more. Therefore, product title quality control is especially important for each system. An efficient model based on the two most popular deep learning models today, CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) for the product title classification problem is presented in the paper. Determines whether a product title is conciseness or not. The model will use many feature groups as input, then they will be extracted again through CNN and LSTM. The combination of features generated from CNN and LSTM will form the most efficient representation vector for each title. In the experiment, we use the Vietnamese product title data set. The results have shown the superior efficiency of the proposed model compared to the base models, such as SVM, Random Forrest, and XGBoost.

articleTitle: Finding Offensiveness in Movie Reviews of Low Level Languages using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: It is human behavior to look for others opinion before taking any decision. A lot of documents are available which express opinions on different issues. But the main challenge arises in analyzing these documents to produce useful knowledge. Tremendous works in the area of Classification is available for English language. However, there has been little work done for Indian languages. From the last few years, opinion-rich resources are booming in Kannada, Tamil, and Malayalam and hence there is a need to perform classification in Hindi. Classification of movie reviews could help in better rating of movies. This work proposes classification for low-resource languages like Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam using Neuro- Fuzzy Technique. This report describes the design and implementation of the algorithm. Classification is a field of Natural Language Processing task which deals with classifying subjective information from the e-resources like blogs, reviews, forums etc. in the form text, image or, video to analyze the class or type of that resource. The purpose is to develop classification model for low-resource language like Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam with use KL-NF and BERT for finding offensiveness in a sentence. A language-independent model was developed capable of operating with any language and datasets of varying sizes. Training and testing utilized datasets from three languages. Following training, the model underwent testing, with results compared between KL-NF and BERT approaches. The accuracy comparison revealed that the BERT model outperformed KL-NF in multilingual classification of offensiveness, achieving an accuracy of 82.7% compared to KL-NF's 82.5%. This suggests that the BERT model offers superior predictive accuracy for multilingual classification compared to KL-NF.

articleTitle: Enhancing Blind Communication With Voice-Assisted Email
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Considering the key role of the internet in daily life, accessibility becomes crucial, especially for visually impaired individuals who heavily rely on it for accessing information. However, a significant portion of text materials on the internet remains inaccessible to blind users, limiting their opportunities for development and inclusion in various communities worldwide. Leveraging audio virtual environments, predominantly through screen reader technology, offers a notable advantage for blind individuals in accessing online applications like emails. This study presents a new design aimed at facilitating the email retrieval for blind users with the utilization of speech-to-text and text-to-speech technologies. This approach is particularly suitable for individuals with average human capabilities and a limited level of education, as it relies solely on interactive voice response for input, ensuring effective functionality for the proposed system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Video Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study provides the utilization of an intelligent video surveillance system, a sophisticated technology that integrates video cameras, sensors, and cutting-edge software to monitor and analyze activities within a designated area or locale. By seamlessly combining compute r vision and machine learning techniques, it goes beyond conventional video surveillance installations to provide real-time insights along with automated alerts. Intelligent video surveillance systems harness the power of machine learning and computer vision algorithms to analyze video feeds in real-time, empowering them to detect, track, and comprehend objects, individuals, and occurrences captured within the video frames. Furthermore, these systems can recognize a variety of objects, including cars, people, animals, and particular objects, even in complex and crowded settings. They also offer a variety of analytical tools and insights that are very helpful to organizations and security operations, such as traffic patterns, heatmaps, and other data. This research study provides a thorough explanation of the modern uses of machine learning in the field of surveillance systems. Two crucial issue statements are addressed by it in practice: the identification of human falls and the detection of auto accidents. This study's main goal is to demonstrate an end-to-end system that will act as a beacon for law enforcement and medical personnel, giving them the ability to quickly identify traffic accidents and serious injuries and guarantee that the necessary assistance is provided on time.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis Based on Signal Processing for Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This work presents a comprehensive analysis of the design and execution of a system aimed at detecting cardiac arrhythmias. Health monitoring, the practice of regularly observing and tracking various aspects of an individual's health such as heart rate, blood pressure, and other relevant data, is crucial. Among these, heart rate monitoring stands out as particularly vital. Any condition affecting the heart or blood arteries falls under the category of cardiovascular disease (CVD). For individuals with serious cardiac disorders, the absence of heart rate monitoring can pose significant risks to heart health, potentially leading to complications and diminishing quality of life. Heart rate, measured in beats per minute, is a key metric in assessing cardiac health. Any irregularity in heart rhythm is referred to as cardiac arrhythmia. A normal heart rate for a healthy individual typically falls within the range of 60 to 100 beats per minute. A heart rate lower than 60 BPM indicates Bradycardia, while a rate exceeding 100 BPM suggests Tachycardia. The heart rate can be effectively measured using devices implemented through MATLAB tools employing signal processing techniques.

articleTitle: Clinical Decision Support Systems for Chronic Kidney Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease, a long-term kidney disorder that leads to high cardiovascular disease, is mainly caused by diabetes, high blood pressure, obesity, and urinary infections. Kidneys are vital organs in the human body, so early detection of chronic kidney disorders is very necessary in order to startthe clinical process. This research mainly aims at categorizing whether the patient diagnosed has chronic kidney disease from the 24 attributes and comparing them with the values in the dataset to start the medical treatments at the earliest. This study has developed and implemented multiple models and the binary classification neural network got the most accurate result with an accuracy of 99.23%. We also noticed a very low loss value, which is 0.023%, due to the ReLu activation layer function in the hidden layer and the hard sigmoid and sigmoid functions in the output layers. Along with this, the other models deployed include Decision Tree, Extra Tree and Support Vector Machine models in order to get the most accurate model for predicting chronic kidney disease from the provided dataset. The accuracy records of the employed models are Extra Tree (98.75%), Decision Tree (95.0%), and Support Vector Machine (93.75%).

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based EEG Signal Classification of Epileptic Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by repeated seizures throughout the day. Epilepsy affects around 65 million people worldwide. For people with focal epilepsy, surgery is a possibility but medicine is the standard treatment for generalized epilepsy. Unfortunately, these medications fail to control epileptic seizures in more than 30% of patients. Yet, this ends up in accidents and significantly shortens the patient's life expectancy. An electroencephalogram (EEG) is a critical diagnostic tool for epilepsy. The conventional method for detecting epileptic activity is expert human interpretation of multi-channel EEG readings. This is a complex and time-consuming procedure, thus many researchers have tried to automate it using Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) methods. Unfortunately, the investigation did not produce satisfactory results. This study aims to fill this research gap by proposing a new CNN-BLSTM (Convolutional Neural Network-Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) based hybrid DL model for epileptic detection. The EEG data from Kaggle was collected and processed. This study uses the same amount of data and epochs for training, validation, and testing all four DL models such as AlexNet, VGG-16, InceptionV3, and the proposed model. According to the experiment findings, the proposed model has a better level of accuracy (98.37<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) than the other three models.

articleTitle: Deriving Insights from Graph Databases using Embedding Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The term Big Data is characterized by features such as Volume, Velocity, Veracity, Variety, etc. It is not possible to handle the Big Data system using only the traditional Relational Database Management System (RDBMS). NoSQL (Not Only SQL) Database Systems are generally used to handle big datasets. In the modern connected world, the relationships between entities are equally important as the entities themselves. Therefore, social networking sites like Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn, among others, make use of Graph Databases to model the relationships that exist between entities/users. In a Graph database, there are nodes representing the entities, edges and the relationships between them. Some of the predominant Graph Databases in use are FlockDB, Neo4j, AllegroGraph, J anusGraph, DGraph, etc. In this research work, the N eo4j Graph Database platform is chosen, and experimental evaluations are conducted to demonstrate that Graph Embedding techniques can be used to map each entity (typically nodes) into a fixed-length vector representation. The performance of the FastRP (Fast Random Projection) graph embedding algorithm is compared with that of the node2vec graph embedding algorithm. The results of the FastRP embedding algorithm are used to perform experiments that showcase how the results of Graph Embedding can be utilized as input for the Machine Learning (ML) pipeline to derive meaningful insights.

Author Keywords: GraphSAGE (Graph SAmple and aggreGatE) Graph Embedding

articleTitle: Brain tumor detection and classification using CNN and resnet-50
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Among the largest problems facing medication is finding and regarding the categorization of the brain tumors. To solve this, a method that leverages Artificial Intelligence and device learning is advised. This includes getting and processing neurological imaging data, separating growths by utilizing Deep Learning techniques, and obtaining radiomic features for classification. For classification, a Models of CNNs are used, and demanding approval and cross-validations techniques are used. To upgrade the selection procedure, the interpretability of the example is addressed. The method has its basis in ethical principles, including data about patients' privacy alongside conformity to regulations, and it is technically relevant. This work develops the brain tumor identification as a topic and categorization and demonstrates the worth of savvy arrives at in medical treatment. The proposed approach lays the groundwork for future developments and AI-driven solutions in clinical settings, benefiting patients and medical professionals.

articleTitle: Efficient Text Database Generation With Large-Scale Data Retrieval Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The process of retrieving and generating complex databases has become a very challenging problem in the era of big data. This study focuses on the generation of J apanese-Chinese text database based on the large-scale and efficient retrieval algorithm. The study starts from the discussion of the large-scale information retrieval algorithm, then the innovative ideas of database generation are combined, and finally the model is applied to the scenario of Japanese-Chinese text database. The key innovation is the agent relevant feedback and hash combined algorithm, the designed hash learning layer consists of nested nonlinear transformation layers and binary layer. While nested nonlinear transformation layers are nested via fully connected network, this research study combines the agent model to make the hash efficient. Then, the data consistency check is combined with the database generation action. In the experimental section, this study takes the Corpus of Spontaneous Japanese(CSJ) data source to test the performance of the model. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is superior to other algorithms, and the labeled dataset can better achieve accurate results.

articleTitle: Amazon Web Services Cloud Compliance Automation with Open Policy Agent
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The security challenges posed by Infrastructure as code (IaC) are outgrowing established security procedures in an era of rapidly adopting cloud computing and DevOps methodologies. Using security principles to be integrated into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous validation and remediation, this research work proposes a DevSecOps approach to enable cloud environment IaC security. The proposed architecture evaluates CloudFormation Template file to the specified security policy by utilizing Open Policy Agent (OPA). Any violations are flagged by OPA, which may force the deployment process to stop. By incorporating security and compliance considerations into the development pipeline, this method guarantees that vulnerabilities are kept out of production systems. Organizations can improve the overall security posture of their cloud systems by proactively identifying and remediating security problems by implementing a DevSecOps approach. By ensuring that IaC deployments adhere to specified security policies based on the compliance requirements, OPA's continuous security validation reduces the possibility of misconfigurations and security flaws.

articleTitle: Setting Up A CICD Pipeline in The Cloud for A Web Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study explores the evolution of software deployment practices from traditional, periodic releases to the agile paradigm, and subsequently to the emergent DevOps approach. Whereas agile methodologies once dominated the industry, the contemporary landscape demands rapid, frequent software deployment cycles. The transition to DevOps facilitates the realization of this imperative, enabling organizations to deploy software multiple times per day. In this context, the ability to swiftly deliver innovative concepts consistently assumes paramount importance. Notably, the DevOps methodology offers a viable solution to meet the exigencies of modern business environments characterized by heightened market demands and the imperative to accelerate time-to-market while simultaneously mitigating failure rates and enhancing consumer engagement. By leveraging the foundational principles of agile methodologies, the DevOps strategy emphasizes the seamless integration of development and operations processes to achieve heightened levels of performance and product quality assurance. Central to the DevOps ecosystem is the paradigm of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CICD), which supports automated software construction, testing, and distribution across diverse platforms. Through the adoption of DevOps tools, organizations can effectively automate comprehensive environment management, thereby streamlining development operations and enhancing overall software development lifecycle efficiency.

articleTitle: Detecting and Recognizing Marine Animals Using Advanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Accurately detecting and recognizing marine animals is crucial for ecological conservation and underwater monitoring. This research analyzes the application of advanced Deep Learning (DL) techniques, including YOLOV5x6, YoloV3, YoloV8, Faster R-CNN SSD, and RetinaNet, to address the challenges inherent in marine environments. It compares the efficiency of these models in handling diverse underwater scenarios, varying lighting conditions, and identifying a wide range of marine species. It evaluates each DL technique meticulously using a comprehensive image dataset representative of marine ecosystems. Evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, and F1-score are employed to assess the models' abilities to detect and recognize marine animals accurately. The comparative analysis highlights each technique's unique strengths and limitations, focusing on their performance in the intricate task of marine animal identification. Scrutinizes Faster R-CNN's region-based approach, YOLO's grid-based methodology, SSD's single-shot detection, and RetinaNet's focal loss mechanism for their effectiveness in differentiating between species, handling occlusions, and robustly capturing the distinct features of marine fauna. It provides valuable insights into selecting and optimizing DL techniques for marine animal detection and recognition tasks. The outcomes aid practitioners and researchers in making informed decisions based on the specific requirements of their underwater monitoring applications, ultimately advancing the state-of-the-art in marine biology and conservation.

articleTitle: Design and Control of PV Based Isolated Power Supply Using iQF Controller for Agricultural
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Electricity is very important in agriculture. Such electricity is not always available to the farmers. Uninterrupted power becomes impossible due to natural disasters, repairs, maintenance etc. The main objective of this research paper is to generate uninterrupted electricity from sunlight, store it and run agricultural equipment. FX5U iQF controller is used as the heart of the standalone power system. FX5U32MTESS controller is used for controlling the mode of operation of standalone power system. Both online mode and offline mode of operations are accomplished by the FX5U controller. FX5U controller has an inbuilt PWM port for controlling the solar tracking mechanism. Produced solar energy is stored in the battery through the charge controller and the same is used to drive the irrigation pump motor. Variable AC is obtained from the inverter part and the DC-DC chopper is used for obtaining the variable dc supply from the battery dc link voltage. The entire power system is easy to move wherever the power supply is required. The parameters of the standalone power supply are monitored by GT27 GOT2000 HMI.

Author Keywords: Electricity in argriculture-FX5U 32MTESS PLC-Online and offline mode of power supply operation - PWM signal for sun traction motor-GOT 2000 GT27 HML

articleTitle: An Approach to Radiotherapy Treatment Planning based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Customizing radiation treatments for each patient is a formidable obstacle in the fight against cancer. Because they rely on human intervention and generalization, traditional methods often provide less-than-ideal results and unwanted side effects. Utilizing patient-specific anatomical and tumor-specific data, this research analyzes the revolutionary possibilities of machine learning for planning radiation therapy. The goal of this research work is to forecast radiation doses, identify tumor boundaries, and reduce the exposure to healthy tissue using Deep Learning (DL), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF) models. Radiation planners must prioritize data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and clinical validation if machine learning has to be widely used. Improved patient outcomes and quality of life may be achieved via the use of Machine Learning (ML) to improve the radiation efficacy and accuracy, as shown in this research study that synthesizes existing research.

articleTitle: Cruise English Intelligent Dialogue System Considering Novel Audio Denoising Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Speech enhancement technology is generally used to suppress interfering human voice and background noise in the mixed noisy speech signal received by the microphone, restore the mixed speech signal to a relatively pure target speech voice which is essential for the efficient signal processing tasks. In this research study, the novel cruise English intelligent dialogue system considering novel audio de-noising algorithm is studied. This article offers a novel 2-step approaches for the systematic analysis. Step 1: The novel speech signal de-noising algorithm is proposed, the systematic modelling is conducted. Step 2: The novel intelligent dialogue system with Rasa is constructed with general framework and speech understanding model. Compared with the traditional approaches such as Support Vector Maachine (SVM), Genetic Algorithm and Neural Network based method, then the experimental analysis is conducted. The proposed model has achieved satisfactory result with accuracy higher than 99% and F-score higher than 90%.

articleTitle: Optimized Scheduling of Electric Vehicles Charging in Smart Grid using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research presents an integrated research framework for electric vehicle charging infrastructures under smart grids. It employs Genetic Algorithms and machine learning models such as Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Decision Trees, and Recurrent Neural Networks. The GA is able to minimally stack waiting times strategically and, by the effective allocation of charging points to drivers at various stages in their route, maximizes usage. In contrast, requiring intensive accurate training on massive data sets are the ML methods, which can also predict future demand for efficient use of resources. Results of the method demonstrate the strength of these techniques, with ANNs reaching nearly 99% accuracy. By applying this comprehensive methodology, operational metrics such as waiting time for EV owners are significantly improved and sustainable power management becomes more feasible. These findings underscore the potential for artificial intelligence to revolutionize energy distribution-so that it balances consumer convenience with tighter environmental targets and ways of working even now taking shape concerning electric vehicle charging.

articleTitle: Auto Temperature Control of Furnace using Intelligent Modular Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Temperature adjustment inside the furnace is a tedious task even though dedicated temperature controllers are available in the marker. Maintenance of stable temperature and pressure is a challenging one. The temperature of the furnace is sensed by the RTD passive sensor or transducer and it is fed back to the Q-Modular Controller. The Q-Modular Controller adjusts the fuel flow system of the furnace based on the reference temperature value. The PID algorithm is developed in the ladder programming by comparing the actual and reference temperature signals from the furnace. The control signal produced by the PID algorithm adjusts the valve opening and closing mechanism of the furnace. The valve open/close is achieved by coupling 12V DC motor with the valve mechanism. Special function modules are installed with the Modular PLC in order to handle the analog signals. Count averaging process is used for sensing the temperature from the furnace and the Digital and Analog outputs are used for performing fuel flow adjustment.

Author Keywords: Furnace temperature control - Standalone temperature controller - RTD - Q-Modular controller - PID algorithm - 12V DC motor - Intelligent function module - Temperature adjustment and Control

articleTitle: Options Trading using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In order to improve prediction accuracy and optimize tactics, this research article investigates the use of machine learning (ML) approaches into options trading. In order to forecast options prices and improve trading strategies, it examines past options data and applies machine learning (ML) algorithms such as support vector machines and neural networks. An empirical analysis evaluates the models' performance by taking into account measures like risk-return trade-offs and forecast accuracy. Successful ML applications in options trading are illustrated by real-world case studies, which also highlight successes and difficulties. This study acknowledges the dynamic nature of financial markets while addressing frequent limitations such as overfitting and data biases. It also provides a path for future study by shedding light on ethical issues and newly developed machine learning techniques. The findings have practical consequences for academics and practitioners and add to the conversation about algorithmic trading and financial decision-making. By deepening the understanding of the mutual benefits of machine learning and options trading, this research study will help investors to make better-informed decisions in today's financial markets. This study addresses shortcomings, recognizes successes and obstacles, and offers insights into new methods and moral issues. The results add to the conversation about algorithmic trading, provide useful takeaways for researchers and industry professionals, and deepen our understanding of the benefits of machine learning for options trading.

articleTitle: Memory-Based Network Model for Intrusion Detection in IoT Using Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The increase in cyberattacks targeting the Internet of Things (IoT) is attributed to the proliferation of network security vulnerabilities. Safeguarding these systems necessitate the identification and classification of malicious network traffic. This study employs a distributed architecture leveraging deep learning (DL) techniques to concurrently mitigate multiple sources of vulnerability within a unified security framework. Bi-Directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) is assessed and compared with alternative methodologies. Evaluation is conducted using two distinct datasets, namely BoT-IoT and NSL-KDD, to estimate model performance and its capability in detecting various attack types. Findings demonstrate that the proposed distributed architecture exhibits high accuracy, up to 99.95%, across diverse configurations, effectively identifying different types of cyberattacks.

articleTitle: Intelligent Automation and Monitoring of Environmental Characteristics for Hydroculture Systems using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The need for adopting Hydroculture systems (viz. hydroponics, aeroponics, aquaponics) is increasing subsequently with the increase in demand for Sustainable farming solutions for populous countries like India. Industrial Hydroculture systems do exist at this current time, but these systems are still far from the reach of smaller scale implementations in terms of cost. The Ambient temperature, temperature of water, pH of water and Electrical Conductivity are considered as the key factors for the growth of plants in such systems. Some of these factors can be controlled and governed as per the requirements of plants. This work aims to develop a proof of concept and automate the process of monitoring, logging and controlling these factors with IoT. The implementation eliminates rudimentary manual monitoring of environmental characteristics, while logging data on an Azure cloud server, with insights delivered via PowerBI.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiovascular Attack Prediction: A Comprehensive Machine Learning Approach for Accurate and Timely Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Cardiac attacks are a leading cause of mortality worldwide, underscoring the critical need for timely and accurate healthcare detection. Predicting cardiovascular attacks is a formidable challenge in clinical data analysis. Machine Learning (ML) proves to be a valuable tool for analyzing vast healthcare data. This innovative approach focuses on employing ML techniques to identify significant features, thereby improving the accuracy of cardiovascular attack prediction. A variety of characteristics and well-known classifiers, including Naïve Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), and Logistic Regression (LR), are used to create the final prediction model. Through collaborative efforts, these algorithms pave the way for binary classification, effectively distinguishing between true and false outcomes. By analyzing their accuracies, this approach enables the possibilities for successful predictions.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review: Tumour Recognition, Segmentation and Classification in Brain MRI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Deep learning models are increasingly employed in medical image analysis, particularly for performing tasks such as segmentation, reconstruction, and classification. These models leverage hierarchical feature learning and data representation, proving valuable in tasks like classifying brain tumors from MRI scans. However, there remains a need for further research on deep learning-based classifiers in the existing literature. This study aims to address this gap by reviewing recent advancements in brain tumor segmentation and sub region classification, compiling various deep learning techniques. This study discusses about different types of brain tumors, recognition of tissue non-linearity, semantic segmentation with fine edges, and classification of tumor sub-regions, highlighting the respective focus areas and presenting the latest and most effective deep learning methods. Through testing the learning capability of these methodologies and contrasting them, this study encourages their widespread adoption. Future suggestions focus on promoting the extensive application of these techniques in medical image analysis for brain tumors.

articleTitle: A Novel Real-Time Machine Translation System based on Cloud LM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research work proposes a novel real-time Japanese machine translation system based on Cloud LM algorithm. The proposed model focuses on 2 aspects, namely: 1. The novel Japanese machine translation algorithm is designed and modeled. 2. The efficient cloud computing framework is designed with the specialized analysis on the data transmission is studied to achieve the real-time translation system. Fort the algorithm design part, the 3-step approach is proposed: (1) the pre-training model for the Transformer model is designed. (2) improved byte pair encoding model considering the Japanese semantic mining is studied. (3) The neural machine translation model based on the hierarchical analysis is considered. Then, the parasitic transmission channel model is designed for the real-time cloud system. The proposed system is validated through the test on the accuracy and cloud response time.

articleTitle: Context-Aware Summarization for PDF Documents using Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In an era characterized by the overflow of textual information, the demand for effective text summarization techniques has become increasingly evident. This research study presents a novel solution to address this demand: the development of a PDF Summarizer Generative AI Platform for context-aware text and document summarization. The developed platform empowers users to generate informative summaries from lengthy textual documents. It features an interface powered by Gradio for enabling user-friendly accessibility. Equipped with essential components such as OpenAI's language models for text comprehension, Chroma vector enables document embedding and conversational retrieval chains for contextual understanding, where the platform offers a comprehensive solution. Users can effortlessly upload documents in various formats, including PDFs, and interactively engage with the system to obtain concise summaries tailored to their specific requirements.

articleTitle: Distributed Ledger Credential Verification System Based on Design Thinking Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study introduces a blockchain-driven solution to revolutionize college credential verification. Addressing the inefficiencies and vulnerabilities of traditional verification methods, the proposed system utilizes blockchain's immutable ledger, smart contracts, and machine learning automation to ensure secure, transparent, and decentralized verification. Results demonstrate its efficacy in fraud prevention, streamlining processes, and providing a reliable, auditable verification platform. This research signifies a transformative shift towards a trustworthy, user-centric credential verification process with implications for students, institutions, and employers seeking streamlined, secure verification of academic records.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-based Encryption Mechanism for Privacy Preservation and Evaluation of Query Response Time in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Data is considered as a resource, where security is a critical factor in the potential growth of data mining. The protection offered by public infrastructure is insufficient to ensure the privacy of personal data. Edge devices are used by analysts to obtain data. Data accessible by unauthorized parties and privacy leaks at the edge layer are prevalent issues found in earlier study. To tackle the problem, this study introduces fuzzy mechanism, which provides differential privacy with Laplace mechanism. This is where operations like query processing and data processing are performed. The data owner encrypts the dataset by using encryption and adds noise after sending it to the data provider and then moves it to the cloud. Based on the uploaded dataset, the data owner employs the encryption technique to generate an index from the recovered key properties. Conversely, the data supplier authenticates the requests and queries made by the data analyst. After that, the edge server's hash tree looks for the matching data, retrieves it from the cloud, and sends it in an encrypted format to the data analyst. A decryption key is given to each verified data analyst to access the query result. MATLAB 2020a is used to perform this task, and the outcomes demonstrate improved throughput, response time and encryption time.

articleTitle: Social Network Data Clustering, Optimal Topic Detection and Decision Making for Social Service
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the era of pervasive social media use and big data, the analysis, clustering, and decision-making based on Twitter data have become crucial for understanding user sentiments and extracting valuable insights beneficial to society. However, a critical challenge lies in accurately identifying optimal topics within the data to facilitate informed decision-making for the public. This research introduces a novel parametric method that integrates various topic modeling algorithms, incorporating visual access tendencies to enhance topic visualization and decision-making across diverse datasets. Additionally, the proposed approach utilizes cluster validity indices to evaluate the quality and performance of derived clusters, ensuring their effectiveness to social network users. Through the application to various Twitter-based networks, the proposed method demonstrates its efficacy in identifying optimal topics and assessing cluster quality for social service applications. This contribution significantly enhances Twitter data analysis by providing a robust framework for topic modeling and data clustering, thereby advancing data management and distribution practices.

articleTitle: Defending AWS Cloud Infrastructure Using Deceptive Defense
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In an increasingly digital world, safeguarding cloud-based resources from cyber threats is paramount. This research study introduces a novel approach to enhance security on Amazon Web Services (AWS) by employing deception tactics within the cloud infrastructure. Leveraging AWS services like CloudTrail, CloudWatch, and Network Firewall, alongside auto-mated re- sponse mechanisms using AWS Lambda and Event-Bridge, the proposed system detects and responds to malicious activities effectively. Upon detection, the system dynamically creates decoy infras- tructure using CloudFormation templates, diverting attackers to simulated environments for further analysis and mitigation. This approach offers a proactive defense strategy, augmenting traditional security measures and bolstering resilience against evolving cyber threats in AWS environments

articleTitle: Tracking and Detection of Moving Vehicles using Hybrid Optical Flow Technique in Complex Transport Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The moving vehicle tracking and detection is the main objective for counting vehicles in a complex transport atmosphere as the traditional optical flow technique could not effectively identify the moving vehicle border in spite of the increased shadow. Additionally, the conventional vehicle tracking framework has faced the issues like the occlusion, shadow and the particle filters have degraded the tracking and detection. This kind of problem is solved through the improved proposed hybrid optical flow framework and the particle filter technique to discover the moving vehicle and utilizes the shadow detection technique into the colour space for marking the shadow location after implementing the segmentation of threshold and additionally combines the shadow removal technique for correctly identifying the moving vehicles. The experimental analysis proves that the proposed technique can provide the solution to the shadow interference and occlusion for tracking the moving vehicles.

articleTitle: Custom Convolutional Neural Network for Cotton Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Cotton is an organic fiber that is grown in monoculture around the world as a commercial crop. It is a vital crop on a global scale because of its economic significance, role in textiles, and effect on livelihoods. Simultaneously, cotton-related diseases have a significant impact on its productivity. The low production of these cotton crops is caused by fungal, bacterial, viral, and other parasite diseases that may change relative to the various circumstances. The loss of nutrition, environmental stress, and chemical imbalance-causing agents are the main causes of natural and common cotton diseases. To improve cotton production, it is important to detect and categorize these diseases at an early stage. So, this work creates a custom CNN model and classify the cotton diseases and compare the performance with various pre-trained model, it determines the algorithm that performs the best and categorizes cotton diseases. it is helpful to detect and classify diseases based on requirements. The findings can guide the selection of appropriate methods based on computational resources, accuracy requirements, and the need for localization information in crop disease management.

articleTitle: ChatFinance: Tracking Wealth with a Conversational Bot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)

authors.preferredName: T V N L Harika Jhansi

abstract: In the ever-evolving realm of financial services, this study proposed a new design and implementation of an intelligent chatbot to addres s the complex requirements of financial management systems. In a rapidly evolving financial lands cape, the wealth manag ement indus try faces the challenge of delivering pers onalized, timely, and efficient services to clients while maintaining cost-effectivenes s. The chatbot developed in this study leverages state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques to interact with clients in a conversational manner. It is capable of unders tanding and responding to a wide range of wealth management queries, from investment strategies to tax planning and ris k as s es s ment. The chatbot's functionality is driven by Machine Learning (ML) algorithms that enable it to recognize user intents, extract relevant information, and provide insightful res pons es. It adapts to us er behaviour and preferences, ens uring a pers onalized and engaging interaction. The implementation of this chatbot signifies a step towards modernizing and optimizing wealth management services to meet the demands of today's clients.

articleTitle: Crop Selection and Yield Prediction using Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The selection of a crop and the prediction of its yield are essential steps in successful agriculture, assisting farmers in decision-making and enhancing crop production. This process involves determining the crop yield per unit area, considering factors such as soil type, weather conditions, and crop management practices. Yield prediction plays a crucial role in modern agriculture, allowing farmers to optimize resource allocation, prepare for potential pest and disease outbreaks, and improve overall farm efficiency. While existing crop yield prediction models provide reasonable estimations, further improvement can be achieved with state-of-the-art algorithms. Various machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Linear Regression, Deep Learning, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), have been applied to support the proposed research on crop yield prediction. These predictions contribute to achieving higher yields and enhancing the quality of crops.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Fake Account Detection Using Machine and Deep Techniques in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Detecting fake accounts is vital in safeguarding Online Social Network (OSN) platforms from malicious activities, ensuring genuine user interactions, and preventing issues like misinformation and fraud. The pervasive nature of fake accounts poses challenges such as social manipulation, disruption of democratic processes, and erosion of online discourse credibility. Businesses also face consequences, including skewed analytics and financial losses. This study employs advanced machine learning algorithms Ada-boost, Cat-boost, Extra'Tree, Long Short Term Memory network (LSTM), Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), and Autoregressive Mode (XLnet) to enhance fake account detection accuracy. The performance of the proposed methods is evaluated using different performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and Fl-score and finally the results are compared. The results shows that Cat-boost is outperforming in all these metrics compared to all other methods.

articleTitle: AI-Based Home Automation Using Voice Recognition and Biometric Finger Print Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The proposed home automation system introduces a cutting-edge solution that harnesses the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to upgrade residential spaces into smart, dynamic, and user-friendly environments. With a simple vocal command, the AI system swiftly and precisely executes tasks. The existing home automation system lacks in authentication so to ensure security and personalization, the proposed system utilizes fingerprint module integrated with a microcontroller like Arduino Uno and Bluetooth module. It interfaces seamlessly with a fingerprint sensor, providing reliable user authentication. This ensures that the smart home system responds only to authorized users, enhancing overall safety. The implementation includes essential components such as Arduino Uno, Bluetooth modules, regulated power supply and fingerprint module. This innovative system showcases the potential of integrating AI into homes, making them not only intelligent but also adaptable to the different requirements of each resident. With speech recognition and fingerprint authentication, this system offers a glimpse into a future where homes are not just structures but responsive companions that enhance the quality of life.

articleTitle: Enhancing Communication Security with a Telegram Bot for Encrypted Image Communication Using F5-LSB Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In response to the increasing need for secure online communication and growing data privacy concerns, this study introduces a technically robust Telegram bot for image steganography. Utilizing the F5 algorithm for JPEG images and the LSB algorithm for PNG images, the bot addresses challenges such as preserving image quality while concealing substantial data and lacking user-friendliness in existing systems. The primary goal of this research study is to establish a secure and user-friendly platform, ensuring accessibility and independence from specific systems. By incorporating encryption, the bot guarantees secure message transmission, making it resilient to interception or detection attempts. This proposed system offers a dependable and efficient approach, harmonizing image quality preservation with effective data concealment for secure communication. The Telegram bot's technical foundation, coupled with advanced steganography techniques, positions it as a versatile and accessible tool, meeting the evolving demands of secure communication in the digital era.

articleTitle: Fusion Data-Assisted Optimization of Holographic System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The quest for authentic three-dimensional (3D) imaging has driven significant advances in holographic projection technology.
