The proposed model explores the integration of computational holography and data fusion methods to enhance holographic display systems. This study presents a novel holographic system combined with a sophisticated data fusion model to improve overall functionality and performance. The proposed system utilizes computational holography to generate robust and reproducible holographic representations that overcome the limitations of physical objects. By synergizing data fusion techniques with holographic imaging, our system maximizes efficiency and adaptability in various applications. Through design, implementation, and optimization, this thesis provides a comprehensive overview of our innovative holographic system and its integration with data fusion, contributing to the advancement of holographic display technologies.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Data Secure Access Using Wireless Light Fidelity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the digital age, securing data transmission has become paramount, necessitating innovative solutions like Visible Light Communication (VLC). VLC, utilizing white Light-Emitting Diodes (LEDs), represents an advanced technology with the potential for integration into conventional communication systems. LEDs offer numerous benefits, including extended longevity. However, as with many emerging technologies, VLC faces technical challenges that necessitate resolution. This study proposes an optical wireless communication system tailored for indoor environments, designed to operate seamlessly with standard plug-in white LEDs. This initiative led to the development of a practical VLC prototype, facilitating an experimental demonstration. Specifically, the proposed research efforts were directed towards developing a VLC prototype compatible with two distinct data transmission protocols-USB and RS-232-without necessitating substantial alterations to existing infrastructure.

articleTitle: Bus Pass Application and Renewal Using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The adoption of cloud computing has brought about significant transformations across various industries, offering scalable, adaptable, and cost-efficient solutions. This study delves into the process of applying for and renewing bus passes by leveraging cloud computing technologies. Traditionally, obtaining and renewing a bus pass involved cumbersome paperwork, lengthy procedures, and limited accessibility. However, by integrating cloud computing, these processes can be streamlined, enhancing user experience. The paper explores the design and implementation of a cloud-based system for bus pass applications and renewals, highlighting its advantages over conventional methods, such as enhanced scalability, improved security, faster processing times, and greater accessibility. Additionally, it addresses the challenges and considerations associated with integrating cloud computing into public transit systems. Ultimately, the research underscores the transformative potential of cloud computing in modernizing bus pass application and renewal services, offering commuters a more convenient and efficient experience. The online bus pass system will enable users to save time by eliminating the need to queue for hours at counters. Those encountering difficulties with the current manual registration and renewal process stand to benefit from the convenience of the online bus pass system. Unlike the manual system, where users must adhere to specific dates and times for renewal, the online system offers greater flexibility and accessibility.

articleTitle: Fall Detection and Protection by Airbag System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Elderly people are the major victims of head injuries and deaths that occur due to falling. Falls are significant concern, particularly among the elderly and individuals as they often lead to serious injuries and a decline in overall quality of life. There are various methods to detect, prevent and protect the aged people from these accidents. All the existing technologies mainly deals with fall detection and alerting. However, fall protection can greatly help the aged people rather than detection. One promising solution is the development of wearable air bag systems that can provide rapid and effective protection when a fall is detected. In this project a mechanism for detecting falls was done and also a wearable air bag system is built for protection. In the designed system, fall detection is done using accelerometer using threshold-based detection techniques. Upon detecting a fall, Arduino triggers the deployment of the air bag through a solenoid valve mechanism. The solenoid valve, controlled by the Tip122 transistor acting as a s witch, regulates the release of compressed air into the airbag, rapidly inflating it to provide cus hioning and protection to the individual.

articleTitle: Dynamic Clustering Algorithm of Remote VHR Images for Object Cost Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: High-resolution remote sensing images are mainly derived from the space-based high-resolution remote sensing and low-altitude airborne remote sensing. Clustering the high-resolution remote sensing images is an important step in remote sensing image processing. The quality of the clustering results will have a direct impact on the subsequent image analysis and the accuracy of the analysis processing. In this regard, this research work studies the dynamic clustering algorithm of remote VHR images for object cost estimation. It is a 2-step approach which contains: 1. novel VHR image dynamic clustering algorithm is proposed to serve as the first step for the efficient segmentation. 2. novel image classification algorithm is designed to make the estimation performance efficient.

articleTitle: Deep Information Retrieval-Oriented Smart System for Construction Project Quota Standards
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Since the 21st century, with the rapid development of computer technology, information technology and network technology, the level of international engineering construction has continued to improve, but the project cost budgets have become more and more complex, and the work intensity has also increased. In this research study, the novel deep information retrieval-oriented intelligent system for construction project quota standards is studied. For the traditional system, the information is always collected by the target users and the model, while missing the latest information from the real-time website, in this research study, the novel website information collection model is first designed. This processing usually includes data cleansing, de-duplication, integration, analysis and visualization to better meet user needs and provide more accurate, reliable and useful information, and the novel steps are discussed. Then, the Continuous Bag of Words combined with Text-Rank word graph construction is considered for efficient information retrieval analysis. Furthermore, the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process is applied to the project quota standards analysis. In the experiment, the focus is on the retrieval model performance, the proposed model is compared with the methods of traditional neural network and Support Vector Machine (SVM), the recall value is selected to evaluate the performance. From the result, it is proved that the proposed model has the better recall performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches in Bioinformatics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Bioinformatics is an interdisciplinary area that combines biology, computer technological know-how, and records to investigate and interpret biological facts. It makes use of computational algorithms, equipment, and databases to understand biological techniques, genetic variation, and relationships among genes, proteins, and different organic molecules. Bioinformatics performs a critical role in genomics, structural biology, and drug discovery. Bioinformatics uses programming languages like Python, R, and Perl, statistical methods, and device gaining knowledge of techniques to investigate and interpret biological records. All things considered, bioinformatics advances our knowledge of biological systems, helps us comprehend diseases, and helps us create personalized medication and specialized treatment plans.

articleTitle: Accuracy Enhancement of Machine Learning Model by Handling Imbalance Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: To enhance the performance of a Machine Learning (ML) model on class-imbalanced data, this study will analyze different approaches toward class balancing. High-class imbalance is inherently prevalent in numerous practical applications such as fraud detection and rare disease diagnosis, making successful categorization with imbalanced data a significant field of study. In addition, the problem is exacerbated by severely imbalanced data because most ML models will show bias towards the dominant class and, in the worst cases, neglect the minority class completely. There has been relatively limited research in the domain of class balancing methods, despite recent breakthroughs in handling imbalance data approaches and growing popularity. In this research, we create and evaluate several methods for balancing data, including Random Under Sampling (RUS), Random Over Sampling (ROS), Adaptive Synthetic Sampling (ADASYN), Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique Tomek (SMOTETomek). We use credit card fraud detection data for our research. This data went through a process of data balancing treatment. Then, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) ML approach is trained with the help of evenly distributed data. SVM mode results for all of the aforementioned balancing data types are evaluated, and the optimum method for handling imbalanced data is determined. The outcome demonstrates that the SMOTETomek method is superior to others in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Utilization of NLP Techniques in Plagiarism Detection System through Semantic Analysis using Word2Vec and BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Detecting strongly paraphrased and translated texts is challenging for existing detection tools as they rely on traditional approach of word searching and matching. Automated systems play a crucial role in identifying instances of plagiarism, thereby upholding the integrity of intellectual work. The study presents a system that detects plagiarism in paraphrased texts using Natural Language Processing Techniques through Word Embedding Techniques, specifically Word2Vec and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). By combining different approaches and techniques, the results showed that the hybrid model achieved 93% accuracy in detecting paraphrased plagiarism. After the integration of the model to the system, the evaluation using the ISO 25010 accumulated excellent results of Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Usability, and Reliability with means of 4.29, 4.29, 4.59, and 4.34, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Transaction Security through Iris Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: UPI frauds have led to increased use of biometrics for personal identification to ensure security and accuracy. Biometric UPI based on iris recognition technology improves customer service by providing a safe and paperless environment. This system replaces the existing UPI pin and affords protection to the UPI payment from cyber-attacks. During enrollment, genuine user's iris samples and UPI ID are retained in the database, and transactions are completed by capturing and matching iris patterns by using G-6 iris recognizer and biometric Framework. This innovative technology has revolutionized the way to make payments and has significantly reduced the risk of fraudulent activities. With biometric UPI, customers can enjoy a seamless experience when making transactions. The use of biometrics also ensures that there is no chance of identity theft or unauthorized access to sensitive information.

articleTitle: Enhanced Blockchain Based Decentralized Public Auditing for Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Considering the development of cloud computing, customers' data may now be accessed remotely from any location via an online cloud server. Thanks to cloud services, users can experience the great ease of on-demand cloud apps, which don't take into account local infrastructure constraints. Since various users may be working together while accessing the data, data sharing becomes essential to achieving beneficial outcomes. In order to ensure that a user's private data cannot be read by unauthorized parties, the current PriCloud security solutions mostly concentrate on authentication. They overlook a small privacy issue, though, which occurs when a user asks the cloud server to look for ways to share data with other users. Additionally, there is PriCloud, which uses blockchain-based private payments and anonymous storage smart contracts to let customers pay their storage providers without giving up their privacy. Whether or not the challenged access request is successful in obtaining the necessary data access rights, it may nevertheless disclose the user's privacy. To address the aforementioned privacy issue for cloud storage, we propose in this work a Privacy-Preserving Authentication Protocol with Shared Authority (PPAPS). The matching method for anonymous access requests in the PP APS allows for shared access authority while taking security and privacy into account. The second stage guarantees a user can access just their own information fields by implementing attribute-based access control. Lastly, the cloud server uses proxy re-encryption to facilitate sharing of data between different users.

articleTitle: Learning Disability Detection and Classification Analysis Between Two Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study presents the analysis of learning disability detection and classification using two classification algorithms. Learning disabilities are neurodevelopmental disorders that affect the ability to acquire and process information. Detecting and classifying these disabilities accurately is crucial for providing appropriate interventions and support to affected individuals. This research analyzes two categorization algorithms: Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Although RF is an ensemble learning method that incorporates several decision trees to produce predictions, SVM is a supervised machine learning algorithm that employs hyperplanes to split data points into distinct groups. This analysis compares the two algorithms' performance in terms of F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. A dataset consisting of features related to cognitive abilities, academic performance, and behavioral characteristics of individuals with and without learning disabilities is used for the analysis. The results show that both SVM and RF achieve high accuracy in learning disability detection and classification. However, SVM performs better than RF because it has greater precision and recall. This indicates that SVM is better at correctly identifying individuals with learning disabilities and minimizing false positives and false negatives. These algorithms can assist in early identification and intervention, enabling targeted support for individuals with learning disabilities.

articleTitle: Towards an Approach for Representing Log Event in Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: With the development of information technology, ensuring the security of IT system is of paramount importance. Currently, AI is being applied to the detection of abnormalities in attacks on IT system. Current anomaly detection models focus on detection based on the appearance of device syslog. However, these models face the obstacle of too large windows size, which affects the performance of the model and the model size is still quite large. This study proposes a graph-based model to overcome the disadvantage of current models. The results show that the proposed graph representation can provide better performance than current models. Experiments with four different datasets all showed F1 reaching a level of 0.992 or higher.

articleTitle: Detection of Alcohol Drug Consumption Among Youngsters using Eye Gazing Movement and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The intake of alcohol and drug consumption among young individuals poses significant societal challenges, necessitating effective preventive measures and early intervention strategies. This study suggests a unique method for predicting youth drug use that makes use of deep learning algorithms and eye gaze movement. This work objective is to use eye gaze movement and deep learning techniques to create a predictive model for young people's use of illicit drugs. The study design involves recruiting a diverse sample of young individuals and collecting their eye gaze data through eye-tracking devices. The collected eye gaze data is preprocessed, segmented, and fed into the deep learning models for feature extraction and prediction. Deep learning algorithms, including ResNet50, VGG19 and Alexnet are employed to extract relevant features and predict the likelihood of drug consumption based on the eye gaze data. The findings of this research highlight the significant relationship between eye gaze movement and illicit drug consumption among young individuals. The developed predictive model shows promising results in identifying high-risk individuals and providing a valuable tool for early intervention and prevention efforts. VGG19 outperforms ResNet 50 and AlexNet with highest accuracy of 0.96. It demonstrates the highest overall performance among the three models for the given task.

articleTitle: Dynamic Feature Selection and Classification for Threat Mitigation in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: At present, Mobile Wireless Sensor Network (MWSN) systems are extensively used in remote monitoring and act as a central point for data transmission in large scale sensor networks. Due to the advancement in MWSN systems, security is a major concern for sensor nodes due physical constraints and high vulnerability attacks. The decision making with regard to data transmission and packet delivery is based on two stages of classification, i.e. normal transmission or attack injected transmission. Various Intrusion Detection approaches and classification methods are available to decrease the feature dimensionality for enhanced classification. This work anticipates a method for feature selection and classification of attacks in MWSN using NSL KDD dataset. Initially, Fisher Scored Cuckoo Search Optimization (FSCSO) algorithm is anticipated for selecting the finest features. Secondly, ReliefF-based Kernel Probability Estimation model (RKPEM) updates the position of each node to generate a mesh specifying the optimal features. Labels in dataset are utilized for recognizing the difference among a set of labelled training features and testing feature sets. From the obtained classification outcome, the severity of attack is identified, and prevented. If attack is not recognized then it is updated in the dataset. The periodic identification of attack type and dataset updation increases the chances of detection rate effectively. The proposed method is simulated in MATLAB software and it worked well in terms of accuracy than the existing techniques.

articleTitle: Empirical Investigation into Social Media's Effects on Academic Performance: A Technical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Providing students with a top-notch education is the main goal of educational establishments. This study intends to use a variety of data mining tools in order to evaluate their effectiveness and determine the impact of different factors on students' academic performance. The res ults of this study establish the groundwork for well-informed decision-making for educators, parents, and legislators by advancing our understanding of the complex interactions between social media and academia. Through identifying plausible positive or negative correlations between social media engagement and academic performance, this research contributes to the development of tactics to optimize the advantages of digital platforms while reducing inherent risks. To examine the dataset, a variety of classification algorithms were used, such as decision trees, random forests, SVM classifiers, and LR classifiers.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Using Sensor Measurements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Accelerometer and gyroscope readings are found to be ubiquitously used for human activity recognition. These sensors are found to complement each other and increase the performance in determining the location and movement of an individual. In this work, the efficiency of multiple machine learning models is tested against six different human activities. Results show that the machine learning models have the ability of differentiating the human activities. The k-NN model is found to have an accuracy of 79.5% while the tree-based machine learning models resulted in an accuracy of 97.7%, which is comparatively high. The distance metric used in k-NN might have a significant role in determining the classes but it fails to handle the non-linearity in data. Finally, this study concludes that the tree based machine learning models are highly suitable for human activity recognition.

articleTitle: Knee Fracture Surgery Monitoring for Advanced Post-Operative System Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: An accurate assessment of joint kinematic patients, who walk with neuromuscular and musculoskeletal disorders may provide essential data regarding modifications of disease status and the efficacy of pharmacological treatments and rehabilitation regimens. This research study introduces a cost effective wearable device for monitoring the long term conditions of joint kinematics patients. The respective data are taken from 17 people, who are made to walk at three different speeds while wearing a retractable string sensor integrated with two points on different regions of the knee joint. The proposed Random Forest (RF) algorithm is used to measure the calibrated sensor inputs. Hence, a wearable device can accurately measure the flexibility of knee angles at different walking speeds during locomotion. This type of wearable technology has a potential to monitor the patients conditions, rehabilitation programmes, and improve therapeutic outcomes.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Prediction of Smartphone Addiction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Smartphone addiction has become a growing concern in recent years, with increasing numbers of people exhibiting symptoms such as excessive phone use, loss of productivity, and even physical and psychological health problems. As a result, there is a need to develop effective tools for predicting smartphone addiction and identifying those at risk. In this study, we built a ML model used for predicting smartphone addiction using data collected from a survey of smartphone users. Demographics, phone usage habits, and a range of psychological issues like stress, anxiety, and depression were all covered in the poll. A popular and effective machine learning method, to build our model. In this study, the data is preprocessed by encoding categorical variables and normalizing numerical variables to ensure that the model could learn effectively. Further, the model is trained on some percentage of the data and evaluated its accuracy and its performance on the remaining percentage of the data using several metrics such as accuracy. The results showed that the model has achieved a high accuracy in predicting smartphone addiction. The most important features for predicting addiction were mobile phone usage patterns such as the frequency of checking notifications, the number of hours spent on the phone each day, and the types of apps used most frequently. Other important factors included age, gender, and stress levels. The model developed has several potential applications. It could be used by healthcare professionals to identify individuals who are at risk of developing smartphone addiction and provide appropriate interventions. It could also be used by app developers to design apps those are less addictive and promote healthier phone usage habits. In a brief, this study illustrates both the practicality and efficacy of using machine learning models for predicting smartphone addiction. Further research is needed to validate our findings on larger and more diverse datasets and to explore the potential applications of this model in different contexts.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Machine learning techniques

articleTitle: Gesture and Emotion Detection using Quantum Computing for Enhanced Recognition and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The research on “Gesture and Emotion Detection using Quantum Computing” is driven by an increasing need to overcome the linguistic and emotional barriers encountered by the Deaf community. With a deep understanding of the complexity of American Sign Language (ASL), this research bridges the communication gap by seamlessly translating ASL into speech, thereby increasing the accessibility for a wider audience. Going beyond mere translation, this research study aims to integrate the converted speech with the emotional expressions inherent in sign language. The proposed research idea stems from the recognition that existing communication technologies often overlook the rich emotional content conveyed through ASL. By integrating facial emotion identification, this research study aims to capture a diverse range of emotions embedded in sign language communication. This dual approach not only increases human understanding but also enhances the inclusivity in linguistic and emotional experiences for both Deaf and hearing communities. Ultimately, the objective of this research study is to develop a comprehensive system capable of accurately recognizing ASL, transforming it into articulate speech, and simultaneously conveying the emotional depth inherent in sign language expression. Through this research study, the emotion-enhanced sign language to speech conversion research seeks to redefine the communication accessibility, enabling a more interconnected and empathetic society.

articleTitle: Early Warning System for Accounting Fraud based on Internet Protocol(IP) Identification and Storage Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study explores the development of an early warning system for accounting fraud based on IP identification and storage algorithms. The proposed approach includes a novel method for IP identification and fraud detection that is both efficient and sensitive. For the IP address detection, the Tor anonymous access traffic identification is the key step. Identifying and classifying Tor anonymous traffic poses a significant challenge due to its scarcity in the Internet traffic, in the design, the XGBoost is used for optimization. To ensure accurate storage of detected information, a system log information storage model is also proposed. The method is tested using an accounting fraud application scenario, which demonstrates its effectiveness in detecting fraudulent activities. The proposed approach has significant potential to improve fraud detection and prevention in various industries. Future studies will investigate the various applications of this approach and its potential impact on different industries.

articleTitle: Comparison of Mamdani and Sugeno Fuzzy Inference Systems to Assess the Health Condition of Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Dissolved gas analysis is an effective method for diagnosis of power transformer incipient faults. In this work, the health status of the transformer is evaluated using fuzzy logic approach. Fuzzy inference systems namely Mamdani type-1 and Sugeno type-1 available in MATLAB environment are taken to perform the task. The gases in ppm and fault levels are given as inputs to fuzzy inference system and health status of transformer is predicted. The results infer that Sugeno systems offer better prediction capability and good accuracy even for varying conditions of gas concentrations and fault levels.

articleTitle: Home Security and Anomaly Detection System: A Comprehensive Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study reviews the home security anomaly detection system and suggests a comprehensive solution to address various aspects of home security. Incorporating features such as motion detection, audio analysis, house surveillance, anomaly and weapon detection, and police station monitoring, this study suggests a new solution to provide individuals with enhanced security options for protecting their home. Leveraging machine learning algorithms, the anomaly detection feature identifies unusual activities within the home environment, while the weapon detection capability alerts authorities to potential threats. Strategically positioned high-definition cameras monitor and document any suspicious behavior, complemented by sound recognition algorithms that identify emergency-indicative sounds. Motion detection sensors further enhance security by detecting unauthorized access.

articleTitle: Multi-Language Medical Symptoms Analyzer and Hospital Locator Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Not every hospital may have a help desk to respond to patient queries regarding the disease prediction based on their symptoms and suggesting appropriate department or medicine, providing precautions for that disease in multiple languages. An automated system, such as a chatbot, can effectively address this issue. The medical chatbot is trained using Hybrid Deep Neural Network-Recurrent Neural Networks (DNN-RNN). The user's query accepted through user interface is pre-processed using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and based on the symptoms disease is predicted using wikipedia summary dynamically. The chatbot is user-friendly, and allows the users to interact in three different languages-English, Hindi and Telugu. It also enables users to enter the location in text, and it using Geopy library, Google Places API, and Folium library hospitals' location information is displayed in the user-specified area. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated using accuracy and loss function. This proposed method is a highly effective learning process, making the chatbot a reliable tool for medical queries and disease prediction based on symptoms.

articleTitle: Anime Visage: Revealing Ingenuity with GAN-Assisted Character Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research explores the fusion of creative ingenuity and machine learning, utilizing Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to revolutionize anime character creation. Collaborating with artists, the study employs cutting-edge GANs to automate the generation of diverse and aesthetically pleasing anime faces, addressing the intricate details unique to the art style. Initial findings indicate significant progress, showcasing the model's ability to capture fine nuances inherent in anime artistry. This research pioneers a comprehensive character design solution, streamlining the labor-intensive manual process. The integration of GAN s into the creative workflow accelerates production while preserving the anime aesthetic's integrity. “Anime Visage” marks a breakthrough, heralding a more efficient and diversified approach to anime character design. The study aims to introduce a mechanism for distinguishing real and generated faces, enhancing credibility. This collaboration between human creativity and automation holds immense promise for the future of anime character design in digital art and animation, ushering in a new era of innovation. Enhancing anime face generation through dataset curation: Losses are reduced and the crucial trade-off between dataset complexity and model performance is brought to light by limiting the size of the dataset.

articleTitle: A Smart Lamp Design Scheme for Myopia Prevention based on 3D Eye Positioning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The evolution of lighting technology has markedly shifted its focus from durability to superior control performance. Modern lighting systems now prioritize advanced features such as the adaptive dimming, color temperature adjustment, and occupancy sensing, superseding traditional emphasis on durability. This paradigm shift enables more efficient energy utilization, significantly improves user experience, and enhances ambient settings. Inspired by this, this research study presents an innovative lighting design framework that attempts to prevent myopia development through a tailored approach. The proposed methodology includes a state-of-the-art 3D eye localization model that optimizes lighting conditions and minimizes the likelihood of myopia progression. Utilizing state-of-the-art sensor technologies and algorithmic techniques, the proposed system tracks and meticulously examines eye orientation in real time and provides customized lighting parameters for each individual. By leveraging these advanced features, the proposed design scheme offers a breakthrough solution that not only enhances visual comfort but also protects eye health. For testing the performance, the ground truth datasets are annotated, and the detection accuracy rate is selected as the metric for evaluation. The proposed algorithm is compared with traditional Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) algorithms. It is evident that the proposed model can effectively detect the eye's position.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mobile Robot Speed Control: PID Controller Optimization with Bio-Inspired Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study presents an investigation into the optimization of PID controllers using bio-inspired algorithms for controlling the speed of mobile robots. The study begins by identifying a mathematical model that accurately represents the dynamics of the DC motor used in robots. Three different tuning methods, namely Ziegler-Nichols (ZN), Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA), and Fish Swarm Optimization (FSO) are then utilized to design the PID controllers. The primary objective is to enhance the speed control performance of mobile robots. To evaluate the effectiveness of the optimization methods, the set speed is given to each of the three controllers, and their performance is compared. The results demonstrate that the optimization techniques outperform the conventional ZN method in achieving the desired speed control. Among the two bio-inspired algorithms, FPA yields exceptional outcomes in terms of time characteristics. The comparison of time characteristics serves as a benchmark for evaluating the performance of the controllers. It reveals that bio-inspired optimization methods, especially FPA, significantly improve the speed control of mobile robots. The time characteristics, such as rise time, settling time, overshoot, peak time, and peak value, illustrate the superior performance achieved through the optimization process.

articleTitle: Implementation of Optimal Crop Recommendation System using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Agriculture consumes a significant 85% of the world's freshwater resources, a trend expected to persist due to growing population and food demand. To overcome this challenge, developing strategic solutions blending scientific principles and advanced technology are essential. Leveraging machine learning technologies, an innovative model is proposed to minimize crop loss due to adverse weather conditions. The proposed integrated system addresses three critical aspects of agriculture: crop selection, fertilizer recommendations, and automated irrigation. By analyzing various parameters such as pH levels, current weather, and soil nutrients (potassium, phosphorous, nitrogen), the proposed model adeptly selects optimal crops based on various environmental factors. A mobile application translates soil conditions into graphical data for easy interpretation. Evaluation of machine learning algorithms reveals Support Vector Machine (SVM) as the highest accuracy at 95.89%, followed closely by Naïve Bayes (NB) at 95.24%. Decision Tree also performs competitively at 95.05%, while K-nearest Neighbors (K-NN) trails slightly with 93.81% accuracy. These findings depict the efficacy of SVM in accurately classifying datasets, presenting a promising path for addressing water demand in agriculture.

articleTitle: Modelling of Advanced Sensor based Distributed Control System for Real- Time Prediction and Minimization of Power Loss in Industrial Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study analyses the integration of a Distributed Control System (DCS) to optimise the efficiency and reliability of industrial automation, with a special emphasis on reducing power loss. Leveraging real-time sensor data and machine learning models, including Decision Trees, Artificial Neural Networks, and Random Forests, the research provides a proactive strategy to anticipating and avoiding anomalous current and voltage patterns. The DCS, armed with predictive maintenance procedures, emerges as a solid framework for reducing energy usage, assuring system stability, and limiting possible quality losses. Evaluation using performance ratings and confusion matrices reveals the efficiency of the proposed system in properly recognising and correcting deviations from normal operating circumstances. The results contribute not only to the progress of distributed control systems in industrial automation but also provide a realistic approach to real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance, supporting sustainability and operational excellence in manufacturing settings. This study sets a platform for future initiatives seeking to construct intelligent, adaptable systems for increased industrial automation performance.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Study of Alzheimer's Detection: Leveraging OASIS MRI with a 19- Layer CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The primary cause of dementia is Alzheimer's disease (AD). It's a condition resulting in a decline in thinking in day-to-day activities due to brain cell degeneration. The cholinergic and amyloid hypotheses have been put forth as causes of AD, which is thought to be a multifactorial disease. The disease is also influenced by several risk factors, including genetics, aging, infections, etc. Since there is no known cure for this disease, many people lose their lives to it every year; however, early detection can help stop its spread. Most victims of this disease are older adults over 60. The reason is still unclear, but it might run in the family. Effective treatment for Alzheimer's disease depends on a precise diagnosis, which poses a serious global health concern. There have been many proposed techniques and strategies; among them, MRI scans are the most widely used. Because MRI is non-invasive and produces high-quality images, it has become a powerful tool for early identification and monitoring. Decision-making in clinical medical care and therapy planning can be supported by computer-aided methods, which have demonstrated beneficial effects for diagnosing and forecasting brain disorders. The paper results in the early detection of AD via a 19-layer CNN and achieved an accuracy of 92 % for identifying the earliest signs of Alzheimer's disease and classifying its various stages.

articleTitle: Empowering Breast Cancer Detection with AI: A Modified Support Vector Machine Approach for Improved Classification Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Breast cancer poses a significant threat to women's health, being a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among female population. In recent years, machine learning has emerged as a promising approach in medical field, particularly in detection and classification tasks. However, existing algorithms often exhibit suboptimal accuracy, necessitating improved methodologies. This research presents a novel approach using a Modified Support Vector Machine (MSVM) for breast cancer classification into benign and malignant categories. Leveraging the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Dataset (WBCD), preprocessing techniques are applied to enhance data quality. Principle Component Analysis (PCA) reduces dimensionality, while linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) extracts discriminative features crucial for classification. The proposed MSVM classifier achieves exceptional performance, with a classification accuracy of 99.42%, outperforming other existing methods such as Deep Convolutional Neural Networks and Fuzzy Rule-based Systems. These results highlight the efficacy of the MSVM approach in accurately distinguishing between benign and malignant breast cancer cases, showcasing its potential as a reliable tool for medical image analysis and cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Computer-Assisted Leukemia Detection and Classification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the contemporary era of technological advancements, the medical field has witnessed significant progress through the implementation of autonomous systems for disease identification. Leukemia, a type of blood cancer characterized by abnormal growth of white blood cells (WBC) in the bone marrow, presents a critical challenge in diagnosis and classification. Manual methods such as morphological image analysis or Complete Blood Count (CBC) are time-consuming and prone to inaccuracies, necessitating more efficient approaches. This research study proposes a Computer-Assisted Leukemia Detection and Classification using Machine Learning (ML) methodology. Leveraging a publicly available dataset from Kaggle, the approach identifies various cell types in images, distinguishing WBCs from red blood cells (RBC) and platelets. Features related to lymphocyte shape and color properties are extracted, followed by dimensionality reduction and classification using a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier to categorize cells into normal and blast. The proposed method is evaluated using metrics such as Mean-Square Error (MSE), Accuracy, Precision, and Recall, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing Machine Learning (ML) systems. This automated leukemia diagnosis approach offers increased accuracy, speed, and efficiency, showcasing its potential to revolutionize disease detection in the medical domain.

articleTitle: Detecting Schizophrenia from Healthy control using Machine Learning and EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: A brain condition called schizophrenia has a significant impact on people's thinking, behaviors, and lives on a global state. The prevalence of the condition rises along with the population, and those who suffer from schizophrenia lose their capacity for thought and behavior with time. All these issues arise because it is challenging to identify schizophrenia patients. As a result, proper care and quality patient treatment require an accurate and quick diagnosis procedure. This article aims to improve the accuracy of. detection by using EEG signals and Machine Learning algorithms. It is tested using the Resting state EEG dataset, which demonstrates a high level of capability in distinguishing between schizophrenia patients and healthy controls. The EEG data is converted to different forms, where the given machine learning techniques extract the EEG signals to identify patients with schizophrenia and healthy control. We are utilizing the 28-file public dataset in this study. In the file, there are 14 healthy individuals as well as 14 SCZ sufferers. In accordance with the findings, (1) the decision tree successfully distinguished SCZ patients from healthy individuals using EEG signals with an accuracy of 89.12%, and (2) logistic regression was also used to successfully identify the affected patient using EEG signals with an accuracy of 69.78%. (3) The SCZ patient was correctly identified by SVM with an accuracy of 65.51 %. Our research demonstrates the potential for machine learning to play a significant role in aiding in the diagnosis of schizophrenia.

articleTitle: Smart PDF Inquiry Hub: A Comprehensive Solution for Efficient PDF Document Querying and Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: With the exponential growth of digital documents, navigating through extensive PDF files to extract specific information can be time-consuming and challenging. This project addresses this issue by providing a seamless solution for users to upload PDF documents, input queries, and receive relevant responses swiftly. The ‘Smart PDF Inquiry Hub’ is a user-friendly application designed to streamline the process of querying information within PDF documents. The application utilizes advanced text processing techniques to handle PDF content effectively. It automatically extracts text, divides it into manageable chunks, and stores them in a Vector Store for quick retrieval. Users can input queries related to the document, initiating a similarity search to find relevant sections within the PDF. The “Smart PDF Inquiry Hub” incorporates advanced question-answering models from OpenAI. These models analyze user queries and extract text chunks to produce precise responses. With a user-friendly Streamlit interface, users can effortlessly upload documents, ask questions, and receive insightful answers. It serves as an invaluable tool for researchers, students, professionals, and anyone dealing with large volumes of PDF documents. By harnessing the power of text processing and machine learning, this application empowers users to efficiently navigate and extract knowledge from PDFs, saving time and enhancing productivity.

articleTitle: Fraud Detection in Digital and Netbanking Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Financial fraud is a dishonest and illegal way to make money. Using dishonest means to gain financial benefit is called financial fraud and has become a threat to companies and organizations in recent years. Despite many measures taken to prevent financial fraud, it shows negative impact on people and businesses as losses from fraud are increasing. Various fraud detection methods have been used over the years. Most previous processes were still done manually; This was expensive, time-consuming, inaccurate and ineffective. More research is being done, but this will not help reduce losses from fraud. Traditional methods such as manual checks and inspections are effortless, inefficient, and costly in detecting these fraudulent activities. With the advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning-based technology can detect fraud by analyzing large amounts of financial data. Therefore, the aim of this study is to recommend payment methods in banking fraud models using the random forest classifier, a machine learning algorithm. Through training and validation, the proposed model is simulated using Banksim dataset.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Feature Selection Methods for ML-Based Kidney Stone Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the field of medical diagnosis, the accurate prediction of kidney stone presence plays a major role. Kidney stones are the solid particles formed due to mineral deposits in the urine, it comes in various shapes and sizes, posing a unique challenge for detection. Various research and imaging techniques have enabled the identification of these stones but their interpretation often requires the expertise of medical professionals. Integrating Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems into clinical practice has proven invaluable, offering practical tools to aid clinicians in their assessments. However, the presence of noise in medical images has introduced errors in kidney stone classification. To enhance the precision of kidney stone prediction, this study proposes a comprehensive investigation into optimized feature selection methods and their synergy with Machine Learning (ML) techniques. The dataset, comprising 1200 images of healthy CT scans and 1200 images of kidneys affected by stones were carefully prepared through image resizing and rescaling. Feature extraction was accomplished using the Gabor filter, followed by the application of three distinct optimization algorithms: Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Bee Colony Optimization (BCO) to identify the most relevant features. The outcomes derived from these optimized feature sets were subsequently evaluated using three different ML models: Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees (DT), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The validation process encompassed nine unique combinations of optimization techniques and Machine Learning (ML) models. The results demonstrate that the combination of ACO with ANN has achieved the highest accuracy of 98% in kidney stone prediction, signifying its exceptional performance in this critical diagnostic task.

articleTitle: YOLO-SpectraWatch: A Novel Architecture for Rapid Suspect Detection in Crowded Urban Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study introduces the Spectra Watch N euralN et (SWNN), a novel integration of a custom-tuned YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection model, aimed at advancing the efficiency and accuracy of suspect detection in diverse surveillance environments. Utilizing the urban surveillance video dataset (USVD), comprising over 100,000 annotated images across various urban scenarios, the YoLO-SWNN model is trained and validated. The YOLO-SWNN model demonstrated higher performance, with an accuracy rate of 93%, precision of 92 %, recall of 89%, and an F1-score of 90%. These metrics were achieved through rigorous evaluation across critical parameters such as processing speed, scalability, and environmental adaptability, establishing YOLO-SWNN's superiority over baseline models like Faster R-CNN, SSD MobileNet, and RetinaNet. The study's findings highlight the potential of advanced neural network models in transforming security and surveillance applications, making YOLO-SWNN a pivotal tool for real-time detection in complex environments.

articleTitle: Voice Activated Assistant for Smart Home Control, Responsive to Commands
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The rapid growth of smart home technologies has provided the possibilities for innovative solutions in home automation which enhances convenience and efficiency in daily life. It presents a comprehensive study on the various designs and advancement of a voice-controlled smart home automation system and assistance leveraging the capabilities of Raspberry Pi platform. The proposed system integrates speech recognition technologies with the versatility of Raspberry Pi, offering users with a user-friendly and seamless interface to effortlessly control their smart home devices. This system which is mainly helpful for disabled people also to control their home appliances and get the data from device in a required audio format. The system architecture comprises a Raspberry Pi micro controller, connected to an array of sensors for controlling various home appliances. The module for voice recognition is implemented using state-of-the-art algorithms, allows users to command and control the connected devices effortlessly through natural language. The incorporation of open-source software and APIs further enhances the system's flexibility and extensibility. Key aspects of this research study include the detailed system architecture, the methodology employed in speech recognition, and the implementation of communication protocols for effective device coordination. The experimental results demonstrate the system's reliability, accuracy, and real-world applicability in diverse home environments.

articleTitle: CNN Design with AlexNet Algorithm for Diagnosis of Diseases in Cassava Leaves
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Plant diseases play a significant role in reducing crop productivity. Nobody will be able to consume the crops because they have been contaminated with different illnesses. As a result, farmers may face huge losses. Cassava is a staple crop in some nations, so this issue may have severe impact on the economy. Detecting plant diseases manually takes time and is prone to errors. It is not always a reliable method for discovering and avoiding the propagation of plant diseases. In order to overcome these issues, cutting-edge technology like machine learning and deep learning may help with early plant disease identification. The main goal of the work is to use deep learning to image classification in order to accurately identify diseases that especially impact cassava plants. This identification may make it possible to implement early intervention measures like specific application of chemicals or confinement of contaminated crops. Each and every test and training image comes from a rural area in the natural world. Using a specific collection of data, the model has been verified to ascertain its true results. In a nutshell this work uses deep learning methods to combat cassava diseases, supporting agricultural practices and food security. The development of a precise disease detection and prevention model has the potential to significantly increase the capacity for recovery of the cassava crop, improving food production and the quality of life for those whose livelihoods depend on this paramount crop.

articleTitle: Packaging Virtual Image-Aided Generation Platform with Digital Twin: Innovations in Image Synthesis and Digital Twin Integration for Product Design Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Packaging Virtual Image-Aided Generation Platform with Digital Twin, combining advanced image generation techniques and digital twin technology is introduced. Departing from traditional 3D model construction, the platform utilizes accumulated images and synthesis techniques for efficient scene representation. Challenges include accurate matching and image fidelity improvement. Practical applications span advertising, fashion, gaming, and data enrichment. Supported by extensive literature, the methodology employs a state-of-the-art image generation algorithm and a GAN network architecture. Conceptualized within a digital twin framework, the platform simulates design tasks and physical entities. The simulation section demonstrates its efficacy in generating high-quality virtual packaging images, offering innovative solutions for product design and expanding digital twin applications.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic-Optimized Clustering for Improving QoS in IoT-Enabled Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have grown significantly in recent years. The initial step in this approach was the deployment of smaller WSNs; later, larger WSNs based on the Internet of Things (IoT) with an increased focus on energy efficiency were deployed. WSNs can be made more energy efficient by using network clustering. In networks, clustering involves dividing nodes into smaller groups and then choosing Cluster Heads (CHs) from those groups. Normal nodes in a clustered WSN are responsible for identifying their surroundings and transmitting that data to the CH, which collects the data and sends it to the base station. Some of the benefits of node clustering in WSNs include reduced routing latency and greater energy efficiency. This study aims to improve the Quality of Service (QoS) of WSN by using metaheuristic optimization. Artificial Bee Colony (ABC), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cat Swarm Optimization (CSO) are the optimization techniques used for the best CH selection. The NS-2.34 software is used for the experiments. Simulation is used to test clustering technique optimization approaches under a variety of nodes. This study compares three optimization methods based on throughput, energy efficiency, and E2E delay. Simulation data indicates that the CSO outperforms the other two techniques.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine Optimization for Employee Satisfaction With Modified Metaheuristic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the contemporary business landscape, the success of a company is intricately linked to the engagement and satisfaction of its workforce. This study analyzes the signifi-cance of developing a contented and engaged employee base, emphasizing the direct impact of workplace satisfaction on productivity, turnover rates, and overall organizational dynamics. Organizational culture emerges as a pivotal factor influencing the recruitment, retention, and satisfaction of talented employees. To address the complexities of identifying and mitigating employee dissatisfaction, this research work proposes a comprehensive solution harnessing the capabilities of cloud-based technologies, specifically text mining, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and modified metaheuristic techniques. The study explores the application of an extreme learning machine as a classifier for assessing employee satisfaction within a cloud computing framework. Acknowledging the critical role of hyperparameter selection in model performance, metaheuristic optimizers and cloud platforms implementation are employed to enhance accu-racy and effectiveness. Furthermore, a novel modification to a metaheuristic algorithm for satisfying the unique requirements of this research is introduced. This research study demonstrates the efficiency of the optimized models, achieving an accuracy rate surpassing 84%. By integrating cloud computing technologies into the proposed framework, organizations gain a powerful and scalable tool for proactively identifying and addressing employee dissatisfaction, ultimately contributing to the improved employee well-being and organizational success in the cloud era.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Non-Invasive Glucose Monitoring Device Using Advanced Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Millions of individuals all over the world are living with diabetes, a chronic condition that necessitates regular monitoring of Blood Glucose Levels (BGL). The present technique for minimal invasive BGL monitoring involves taking a small blood sample and transferring it to a glucometer. However, this procedure can be uncomfortable for the patient. This research presents a method for non-invasively monitoring BGL with the help of a powerful controller called the ARM Cortex-M4. For non-invasive applications, we use photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. Using a photodiode and an infrared LED light, PPG samples are received from a finger sensor. Signal processing and feature extraction are carried out using the Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) method. To predict the BGL, two ML models are developed: one employing a Linear Regression (LR) model and the other an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model. The experimental findings show that the ANN model is quite effective, with an R2 score of 0.986. After careful consideration, the ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller's processing capabilities were found to be optimal for running the ANN model. The model must be fine-tuned before deployment so it can communicate with the microcontroller and provide correct inference in real time. The finger sensor simplifies PPG sample collection, and the OLED display makes it simple to view BGL.

articleTitle: Detection and Prediction of Liver Disease Using Interpolative Ensembled Stacked (IES) Hybrid Model (Random Forest Classifier (RFC) and Logistic Regression (LR))
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This work proposed an Interpolative Ensemble Stacker hybrid algorithm named Random Forest Classifier and Logistic Regression in the prediction and detection of liver disease. The ensemble model harnesses the strengths of both algorithms to enhance predictive accuracy. Leveraging a diverse prompt feature, the proposed model achieved impressive accuracy. The Random Forest component contributes to its ability to handle complex interactions and non-linear relationships, while Logistic Regression provides interpretability and simplicity. The synergy between these models not only improves predictive performance but also enhances the transparency of the decision-making process. In this work, a comprehensive comparative analysis was also performed between proposed and established models. This proposed ensemble approach holds promise for accurate and reliable liver disease prediction, offering a valuable tool for early diagnosis and intervention in the healthcare domain.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Detecting Subtle Signs of EyeDisease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Eye disorders can have serious repercussions, such as blindness or visual impairment, if they are not identified or addressed, Treatment that works and preventing permanent harm depend on early diagnosis and prediction. Using cutting-edge clinical observations, this method looks for diseases such diabetic retinopathy, cataracts, myopia, glaucoma, age-related eye illnesses, and hypertension-related eye disorders. This study presents an innovative method for early detection of eye health disorders: The Eye Health Station. It uses machine learning algorithm, by leveraging EfficientNet's superior performance in image classification tasks, our system analyzes ocular images, such as retinal scans, to identify potential indicators of eye disorders at an early stage., The proposed system seeks to discover possible markers of eye problems by evaluating several factors taken from ocular pictures and patient data, including retinal scans and medical history. The system is able to learn from various datasets and gradually increase its accuracy since machine learning techniques are included into the system.

articleTitle: Machine - Learning Based Prediction of Stability of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The term “smart grid” refers to a sophisticated power system concept that combines communication within a system network with electricity. It gives real-time access to diverse data to customers, operators, and manufacturers. The need to distribute this electric power to the consumer domains - houses, industries, businesses and smart cities, efficiently is quite big. In order to meet the exact power needs, a smart grid with more stable systems is being used. Stability predictions for smart grids remain difficult. Participation from producers and customers is one of the many factors that determine stability of grid. The smart grid's stability may result from participant identification. This study utilizes a machine learning technique to identify the smart grid's stability. In various studies, popular classifier models such as Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree and Bagging Classifier are used to compare the results of the proposed model. With an accuracy of 96%, the proposed model of Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM) performs better than the others.

articleTitle: Analysis of Satellite Images for Historical Maps Classification using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Remote sensing is concerned with high-resolution geographical data. Its applications include farming, water resources, ecology, forests, deserts, marine applications, soil types, disaster alerts, and management. To extract the necessary information from satellite images, considerable image processing is required. Image segmentation and categorization into land cover categories is an important stage in satellite image processing. This article describes a method for categorizing and detecting different forms of land cover from satellite data. In this study, we examine satellite images for historical map classification using machine learning algorithms. We acquire Landsat images to complete this tedious task. The images are carefully labeled using the ArcMap software. We categorize areas into five types: forest, building, water, barren, and agricultural land. The images are then sent to the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Model for feature extraction. The retrieved features were then exposed to three Machine Learning (ML) models: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and Decision Tree (DT). Standard classification measures are used to analyze the outcomes of all three models. When compared to the other two models in satellite image classification, CNN feature extraction with SVM classifier achieves the greatest accuracy of 95%.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Through Feature Weight Optimized Lasso Regression (FWO-LAR)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The massive growth of internet enabled devices increases the users every day active in social media networks. People on social groups getting instant alerts on news, entertainment, education, business and many more. The mode of communication and message transfer through social networking groups have become wider. On the other hand, fake information is widespread over the network through malicious user profiles. These kinds of information change the people perspectives on sensitive matters like social issues, political, religious even more. Detection of fake news and trustworthiness in the received information is important. Considering the major problem of fake news spreading in the social networking groups, an effective system to detect the trustworthiness of the information transferred in the network is considered. The proposed system focused on creating a feature weight optimized lasso regression (FWO-LAR) model for efficient detection of fake news. The system considers the twitter dataset PHEME towards working on goal of detection of fake keywords and fake information associated within the given data. The presented system analyzes the dataset and further evaluate the correlation score, accuracy of detection using FWO-LAR model as 98.7% is achieved with current analysis. The presented study achieved with fast detection of fake news present in the sample data opted under testing. The presented system is compared with existing state of art approaches in terms of performance measure and false positive rate reduction.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Agriculture: Deep Learning-Based Crop Monitoring Using UAV Imagery - A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: As global agriculture demands continue to surge, there is an imperative need for innovative technologies that enhance crop yield and quality. The aerial IoT platforms are reshaping the landscape of plant stress analysis ultimately contributing to farming practices. In recent decades, remote sensing has drawn a lot of attention as a way to track how plants react to environmental restrictions. One of the biggest issues among these seems to be climate change. The creation of trustworthy technologies for identifying plant diseases and plant stress is the industry's present problem. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and hyper-spectral imaging technologies show great promise for monitoring plant stress. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles or Drones are used in aerial IoT platforms for plant stress monitoring with abiotic factors, which are built with sensors and other common devices to collect data about the environmental conditions and responses of plants under various stresses like drought, salinity, temperature, light, etc. This review article provides a better understanding of UAVs and the Internet of Things (IoT) for aerial imagery surveys and comparative analysis. The systematic review also reveals the emergence of advanced deep learning techniques, showcasing their suitability in developing robust methods for aerial imagery vision applications in sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: DataDAO Club - Revolutionizing Investment Management with On-Chain Governance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) have become a transformative force in the ever-evolving landscape of decentralized finance (DeFi), reshaping traditional investment frameworks. This research thoroughly examines the intricacies of DataDAO Club, an innovative platform that utilizes on-chain governance, Filecoin storage, and smart contracts to redefine the landscape of investment management. The study encompasses an in-depth literature review, delving into the broader context of DeFi, previous DAO research, and the integration of block chain technologies such as Filecoin. The methodology section meticulously dissects the smart contracts deployed on the calibration testnet, showcasing real-world implementation through features like on-chain governance, economic models for dataset value generation, and proof of data storage inclusion (PoDS I). The findings shed light on the platform's impact, emphasizing its role in democratizing access to investment funds, evaluating the efficacy of Filecoin storage deals, and assessing the resilience of the implemented features. This study not only reveals the intricate workings of DataDAO Club but also discusses user interactions, delves into the challenges encountered during development, and proposes potential avenues for future improvements. This research contributes valuable insights to the ever-changing landscape of decentralized finance, offering a nuanced understanding of the practical implementation and impact of DAOs, thereby paving way for continued innovation and exploration in the field of decentralized investment management.

articleTitle: Implementation of Cross Layer Design with Localization Techniques in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study addresses the integration of wireless sensor networks, machine learning models, and go-layer architecture to embellish industrial processes in small-scale manufacturing. A strong monitoring infrastructure is produced by the incorporation of various sensors, proximity, temperature, pressure, vibration, UWB, and RFID. Cross-layer arrangement, along with localization methodologies, gives spatial context to sensor information, enhancing safety, predictive maintenance, and asset monitoring. K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Decision Trees (DT) act as predictive models, exhibiting outstanding overall performance across accuracy, precision, keep in mind, and F1 Score criteria. Practical deployment in a small-scale firm, displaying CNC machines and forging stations, illustrates the machine's versatility. Results suggest the models' success in forecasting replies relying completely on dynamic sensor data, allowing actual-time selection-making. The system's usefulness supports enhanced safety measures, simpler maintenance processes, and optimal asset management. In addition to offering practical insights to organisations navigating the challenges of Industry 4.0, this research adds to the theoretical framework of move-layer layout and machine learning integration. The suggested system emerges as a complete solution for intelligent operational improvement and performance in modern day industrial settings.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Classification of Cataract Infected Eyes and Normal Eyes using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Cataract, a common eye disease characterized by clouding of the natural lens of the eye, is a serious threat to visual health. If left untreated, they can lead to blurred vision and even blindness, underscoring the importance of timely intervention. To address the urgent need for accurate cataract diagnosis, this study provides an improved approach using convolutional neural networks (CNN) to distinguish cataract eyes from eyes with normal vision. Because cataracts are the most common cause of visual impairment worldwide, recognition and accurate classification are critical for prompt intervention and mitigation of potential harms. Taking advantage of recent advances in deep learning, especially CNNs, this method introduces a new feature extraction technique that uses hyperparameter optimization. The systematic exploration of the hyperparameter space determines the optimal configuration that maximizes the efficiency of the classification algorithm to distinguish cataract from normal eyes. Experimental validation on a comprehensive fundus image dataset demonstrates the effectiveness of this approach, achieving robust performance and high classification accuracy. A deep learning approach with optimization techniques will improve the efficiency and accuracy of cataract diagnosis, offering promising solutions to alleviate the global burden of vision loss and blindness.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity KPIs in Higher Institutions: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study systematically reviews the cybersecurity KPIs in the higher education industry. With the evolving technological landscape, higher institutions are facing significant advantages from teaching and learning methods impacting all the stakeholders. However, on the other side they are facing several cyber security threats that have led several stakeholders of higher institutions to face losses and repercussions. The ever-increasing threats and malpractice brings the attention for higher education institutions to adopt effective cybersecurity KPIs. This study aims to focus on assessing the evolution of the research topic and its trends and documenting the rising awareness, implications, and challenges of adopting cybersecurity KPIs within higher institutions. Through a detailed analysis of a systematic literature review, it highlights the various adoption of KPIs within higher education institutions and their outcomes. We use a systematic study from 12 papers between the years 2011 to 2023 that were a part of inclusion criteria which supports the study of this paper. Furthermore, it discusses the stakeholder's implication and the importance of considering cybersecurity KPI by all stakeholders and not just the IT department, hence it needs to be implemented and measured by the rest of the stakeholders in order to achieve it successfully. The findings of this study recommend 15 KPIs of cybersecurity, keeping the model of Kirkpatrick's as a guide developed by previous researchers. The KPIs are chosen based on the systematic review and are recommended by future authors to conduct a survey based on the content validity method in order to validate that the developed KPIs are effective and suitable to be used by higher education institutions in the future.

articleTitle: IoT and wireless sensor network -Based Three- Tier Architecture for Continuous Cardiac Health Monitoring and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study suggests a powerful Three- Tier Architecture that combines machine learning models, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and sophisticated sensors to provide continuous cardiac health monitoring. A range of physiological data is provided by the sensors in the Data Collection Tier, which measure blood pressure, temperature, acceleration, and electrocardiogram (ECG). In the Data Processing Tier, a local server applies complex algorithms to efficiently assess the gathered data and provide insightful outcomes. By providing easy access, authentication, and alarm production, the Application Tier acts as the interface and guarantees efficient contact with healthcare providers. The unique aspect of the system is the integration of machine learning models, which were trained on recorded data for predictive analysis. k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Decision Trees (DT), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are some examples of these models. Impressive accuracy levels are seen in the results, with ANN leading at 96.44% The measures of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score all demonstrate the algorithms' capacity to anticipate possible health risks, which supports the models' effectiveness.
