This proactive paradigm in healthcare is made possible by the comprehensive approach of continuous heart health monitoring, which enables prompt interventions and customized treatment strategies. This study increases our knowledge of the dynamics of cardiovascular health and the rapidly growing field of health care technology by demonstrating the synergy of sensor-based monitoring, IoT connectivity, and machine learning analytics in a unified architecture. In the end, patient care is improved.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Geospatial Data Storage Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Geospatial data warehouse tools effectively address the challenges posed by evolving requirements, ensuring the adaptability to diverse geospatial datasets. Prominent among these tools are Google BigQuery, PostGIS, Amazon S3, and Oracle Spatial and Graph, which are tailored for data warehousing and operations, geospatial data manipulation, and leverage Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) for data integration and interoperability. Detailed analysis of each tool's performance, security, scalability, flexibility, and cost reveals the mechanisms, which guides the informed tool selection. These warehouse tools are strategically integrated and leveraged based on specific conditions to efficiently retrieve and visualize data. They adeptly fulfill various requirements including data warehousing, processing, and analysis, thus contributing significantly to geospatial data management and operations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cross-Language Communication with Recurrent Neural Networks in a Smart Translation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The Smart Language Translation System (SLTS) is an innovative solution designed to bridge language barriers and facilitate effective communication across different languages. Language translation plays a crucial role in today's globalized world, where multilingual interactions are increasingly prevalent in various domains such as business, academia, and international relations. Traditional approaches to language translation relied on rule-based systems that involved extensive manual coding and linguistic analysis. However, these methods often struggled to handle the complexities of languages, leading to limitations in accuracy and scalability. This study tries to automate a language translation system using Deep Learning (DL). Further, this study utilizes two specific RNN architectures: Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network (Bi-RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). These models are trained and evaluated using various metrics and performance measures, including BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy), precision, and NIST (Normalized Information Similarity Metric). The evaluation aims to identify the most effective RNN architecture. The study encompasses the entire translation pipeline, starting from preprocessing tasks such as cleaning, tokenization, encoding, and padding, followed by model construction training and evaluation. The results reveal the superiority of the Bi-RNN model over LSTM in terms of BLEU, precision, and NIST metrics across different word count ranges.

articleTitle: Detecting Cancer through Analysis of Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Prostate cancer stands out as one of the most prevalent cancers, ranking second in cancer-related male fatalities on a global scale. Early diagnosis and effective treatment are pivotal in halting the proliferation and dissemination of cancer cells within the body. The gold standard for prostate cancer detection remains histopathological image diagnosis, distinguished by its unique visual attributes. Nonetheless, the interpretation of these images necessitates a high level of expertise and is often time-consuming. One promising field to expedite this diagnostic process lies in the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly through the utilization of Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems. This study is dedicated to the categorization of histopathological images into “normal” and “prostate cancer-affected” categories, utilizing the extensive PANDAS dataset. In this study, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are employed to extract relevant features, and three distinct machine learning (ML) models-Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Naïve Bayes (NB)-are applied. The experimental findings of this study highlight the superior performance of the SVM model, which achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 98%, while also exhibiting minimal false negative and positive rates of 1.98% and 2.01%, respectively. This research underscores the potential of AI technology in prostate cancer identification.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Malignant and Benign using Adaptive Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Malignant is the most dangerous type of skin cancer, and it is among the most common varieties worldwide. In order to improve patient outcomes and reduce mortality rates, early detection is of vital importance. In recent years, deep learning models have demonstrated promising results on a variety of imaging tasks, including skin lesion classification. In this paper, we propose a method for the early detection of malignant and benign skin lesions using the ResN et50 convolutional neural network architecture. After training on a large dataset of labelled pictures of skin lesions, the proposed model achieves high accuracy in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions. Additionally, the implementation of a GUI interface enhances user accessibility and ease of use. The results highlight the effectiveness of the ResN et50 model in facilitating early detection, while the GUI interface augments its potential applicability in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Design of Robust Hospital Nursing Call Communication System Considering Anti-Collision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Hospitals have long struggled with inefficient and unreliable communication methods, relying on manual techniques such as yelling or loudspeaker systems. These methods are not only complex but also prone to error, resulting in delays and potential harm to patients. In response, this research work presents an innovative solution: a robust nurse call communication system that utilizes an anti-collision algorithm. This innovative approach is revolutionizing communication within hospitals, promoting the timely and accurate exchange of information to improve patient care and safety. The study boasts several groundbreaking innovations, including: (1) The pioneering IoT communication method harnessing RS-486 technology, significantly enhance data transmission efficiency and reliability. (2) The proposed call communication system carefully considers anti-collision algorithms, empowering simultaneous transmission of multiple calls sans any interference. (3) The holistic and resilient hospital nursing call communication system seamlessly integrates the above innovations, offering a dependable and streamlined solution for healthcare facilities. Together, these advancements represent a significant step forward in the quest for optimal healthcare communication methods that can significantly improve patient care and safety. In the experimental phase, the proposed system was carefully designed and implemented, and a thorough study of the relationship between the volume of conflict detection tasks and the corresponding time requirements was conducted. The results clearly demonstrated a linear relationship between the two variables with the novel algorithm showing superiority over its traditional counterpart in terms of overall performance.

articleTitle: Secure Shader Execution via Early Termination and Throttling-A Review of Recent Literature and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Graphics processing units (GPUs) are increasingly used in security-sensitive domains, making side-channel attacks on shader execution a pressing concern. This paper reviews recent research on side-channel vulnerabilities in GPU shader execution and examines limitations in existing defences. The study highlights gaps like a lack of lightweight runtime attack monitoring leveraging GPU features, the absence of detection models suited to noisy shader data, and deficient response mechanisms exploiting unique GPU capabilities. The study then proposes research directions to develop a secure shader execution framework integrating continuous performance monitoring, isolation forest anomaly detection, and early termination and throttling defences customised to GPU architectures. The goal is to mitigate side-channel attacks on commercial GPU s reliably and with minimal overhead.

articleTitle: Students' Experiences on Covid-19: An Automatic Classification Using Machine Learning-Based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic that struck the world in 2020 caused severe disruptions to the economy and society. The digitization of instruction has brought about a significant change in the realm of higher education. With this, Cagayan State University – Sanchez Mira introduces innovative techniques to combat the negative effects of pandemic to students' educational, social, family, personal and health journey. The main purpose of this study is to classify the experiences of students of CSU-Sanchez Mira during COVID-19 outbreak. In this experiment, machine learning was done using RapidMiner. The first level of categorization involved labeling statements as having good or negative experiences. The second level of segmentation entailed grouping experiences into categories based on how they related to personal, family, education, social, and health experiences. Statements that are unfavorable outnumber those that are favorable. Since the focus of this study focuses on the viewpoints of students, the bulk of statements were on experiences related to school. The f-score and accuracy increase when the aforementioned traits are added to the classifier, indicating that the features enhance the classifier. The majority of ratings were average, according to the results, which may have been a result of noise and insufficient data. Nevertheless, every accuracy score that was reported during the test was more than 60%, indicating a relatively accurate classification. The Naive Bayes approach has the most accurate classification outcomes. The 80.65% accuracy of Naive Bayes classification throughout the experiment is promising, aligning well with recent outcomes in opinion mining research in recent years.

articleTitle: Encryption in the Cloud: Analysing Deep into the Layers of Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study focuses on the intricate domain of cloud security, highlighting encryption's crucial role in safeguarding data integrity. Beginning with a comprehensive introduction to cloud encryption, this study explores the fundamental concepts and contemporary encryption methodologies. Examining the shared responsibility model, complexities surrounding key management, data residency challenges, and the emerging threat of insider breaches, it tackles cloud security challenges. Analysing deep into the layers of cloud encryption, this study explores the strategies used for securing the data in transit, at rest, and within applications. Empirical case studies illustrate the successful implementations and security breaches, offering valuable insights. Additionally, it addresses compliance, outlines key management practices, discusses about cloud encryption deployment, and provides guidance on integrating it with existing security protocols. Concluding with an analysis on the potential future directions, this study serves as a comprehensive reference for security professionals, IT experts, and decision-makers navigating the intricate landscape of cloud security, for enhancing the security of cloud-based environments.

articleTitle: Distributed Online Video Management System Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study focuses on the design and implementation of a distributed online video management system based on cloud computing. First, this study introduces the basic concepts and development history of distributed systems, highlighting their advantages and challenges. Then, provides an overview of the current state of online video management systems and identify existing problems. To address these issues, this study proposes a novel distributed online video management system that utilizes cloud computing technologies to efficiently manage and distribute video data. In terms of video compression, a new algorithm based on perceptual compression that significantly reduces the size of video data while maintaining high visual quality is proposed. In addition, this study also presents a distributed online video analysis model, which utilizes the Hadoop framework to efficiently process large amounts of video data. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed distributed online video management system is verified through experiments, demonstrating that it can significantly improve video management efficiency while maintaining high video quality.

articleTitle: Crypto Predict: Price Forecast & Trading Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Cryptocurrencies are computer currencies used in recent times. This research study proposes a new model to predict the value of the main cryptocurrency, Bitcoin. To estimate the cost accurately, various parameters will be selected. In this study, a variable detection mechanism is adopted to obtain a stable prediction function in the absence of multiple values. Additionally, on-chain information (the particular data that a cryptocurrency has listed on the blockchain) is gathered and applied as an alternative method of value estimation. Global BTC price data and tests in various locations show the effectiveness of this model in BTC price prediction. The proposed system will bring good results to investors and day traders.

articleTitle: Examining Cyber Threats and Vulnerabilities: A Deep Dive into British Columbia's Cybersecurity Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: With the increasing number of cyber-attacks and threats globally, analyzing mostly issued cybersecurity alerts and advisories is necessary to strengthen digital defences and protect critical infrastructure from cyber risk. This exploratory research paper presents an in-depth analysis of cyber-security alerts and advisories, along with major aspects of British Colombia, a world-famous region of Canada, focusing on trends, vulnerabilities, and their implications. Extracting data manually from 805 and additional distinct websites resulted in a comprehensive dataset that provides valuable information about the frequency, severity, and categorization of cybersecurity threats. This analysis also reveals prevalent vulnerabilities such as code execution, path traversal, and authentication issues, emphasizing the diverse nature of cyber threats organizations encounter nowadays. In addition, an impactful assessment with concrete evidence highlights the paramount consequences of these vulnerabilities on organizational data security, integrity, and operational continuity. By consolidating analysis findings into a single document, valuable information about emerging cyber threats and vulnerabilities in British Columbia can be obtained. By consolidating analysis findings into a single document, valuable information about emerging cyber threats and vulnerabilities in British Columbia can be obtained, and helps in developing strategic responses to enhance cybersecurity resilience and protect critical infrastructure and future advancements in the field of research.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Graphical Passwords Authentication Systems that Provides Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In today's data-driven world, the importance of cybersecurity has grown exponentially. The biggest threat to data can be tampering with the authentication system that is the gateway to digital assets. The aim of this survey is to give a comprehensive overview of all relevant technologies, architectures, processes and literature. This research study discusses about the various dimensions of a graphical authentication system, including privacy, threat detection and access control mitigation, encryption, and user awareness. Authentication system graphics proved to be an innovative alternative to traditional alphanumeric passwords to improve user security and convenience. Dive into knowledge-based authentication, which includes picture passwords that are said to be more convenient for humans to remember passwords. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the underlying concepts, implementation techniques, challenges, types and potential future reach of the graphic passwords. In addition to discussing the benefits, it also discusses the security, usability, privacy, and implementation challenges of these methods.

articleTitle: Optimizing Traffic Safety Through Bentley's MicroStation Data-Based Highway Intelligent Design Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study delves into the multifaceted challenges of urban rail safety, highlighting the intricate interplay among technological complexity, administrative oversight, and human factors. It proposes an innovative parallel data-driven intelligent design system tailored for highways, harnessing the capabilities of Bentley's MicroStation and integrating gesture-based somatosensory technology, with the aim of enhancing the safety and efficiency of urban transportation. The literature review comprehensively explores road safety issues, encompassing cognitive incentives, the coexistence of autonomous and manual transportation, and the impact of automated driving. The systematic model synthesizes these findings and underscores the significance of terrain modeling and the integration of somatosensory 3D human-computer interaction for authentic three-dimensional road design. Moreover, the paper stresses the importance of conducting reliability assessments prior to the trial operation of urban rail transit projects, evaluating key indicators to uphold elevated operational standards. Experimental results from recently commissioned rail lines unveil distinct failure patterns, particularly a prevalence of vehicle failures in the third stage of operation, while affirming the overall reliability of specific functionalities such as signaling and door systems. In essence, this article offers a nuanced exploration of urban transit safety challenges, innovative roadway design solutions, and insights from relevant literature to present a holistic perspective on optimizing traffic safety in urban transit systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and MANET-Driven 5G Technology for Smart Healthcare: Enhanced Patient Diagnosis and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This article presents the design, development, implementation, and evaluation of a system for patient health monitoring by synergistically combining machine learning models, mobile ad hoc networks (MANET), and Internet of Things (IoT). In this patient health monitoring system, data are gathered from numerous sensors installed on IoT devices in real-time to support dynamic and continuous health monitoring of patients within predefined constraints. The data are sent over MANET, which has nodes that send data to cloud storage for a centralized management. The data collected from the patients are used to train various Machine Learning (ML) models to learn when the patient is likely to experience a health problem. The analysis carried out in this study reveal that the Support Vector Machine (SVM) is found to be the most accurate model for predicting patient health problems, with an accuracy of 91.23%. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes (NB) rank next, respectively, with accuracy of 88.7%, 86.5%, and 84.4% respectively, following SVM. Recall, accuracy, and F1 score are given to provide comparative information on the relative merits of these models. This integrated healthcare monitoring system, with its timely alert system, real-time monitoring, and powerful predictive analytics, provide patients with personalized and proactive care. It enhances healthcare practices by showing that the data-driven strategic approach and its associated technologies are transforming patient outcomes in the emerging field of healthcare.

articleTitle: Document Summarization Using Multi-Objective Weighted Graph Embedding Feature and Optimized Rank Based Deep Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The necessity for automatic text summarizing techniques is growing in the modern day. The primary goal of extractive multi-document summarizing techniques is to eliminate unnecessary information while simultaneously obtaining the essential content of a group of documents. Multi objective weighted graph embedding feature with an Optimized rank based deep Convolutional Neural Network-Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory classifier (MOWGEF+rank deep CNN-BiLSTM model) is developed by this study for multi-document text summarization. The process of text summarization begins with two stages preprocess document to prepare for input as a multi-document summary and extract multi-objective weighted graph embedding features from its content. The profound achievement of this paper is to regard weighing model as a weighting for semantic information of word, phrase and sentence relationships. This model also has a conventional entropy-based feature selection technique that aids in finding significant variables. For the optimized rank-based deep classifier model these attributes are utilized as the input which captures the document intricate details. The optimized rank-based deep classifier's novel layer assesses words according to the significance they have become in a document. This arranging takes place using a novel optimization method that generates sentence ranking, demonstrating a unique and effective approach to multi-document summarizing. Elytron Vespid-B optimization (EVO) algorithm essentially takes inspiration from the foraging behaviors of insects, fine-tune the classifier's parameters to optimize its performance. Based on the achievements the model attains high recall 1, recall 2 and recall L values of 0.77, 0.39 and 0.75 respectively for DUC 2002 database.

articleTitle: Design of Image Kernels using Reversible Logic Gates: Enhancing Image with Information-Preserving Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study demonstrates the design of several image kernels and reversible logic gates to carry out various functions such as enhancement, blurring, sharpening, and embossing of a greyscale image whereas image kernels are used in the convolution process. These six filter kernels are designed using the reversible logic gates, and the image kernel metrics are measured in terms of Gate count, Ancilla inputs, Garbage outputs, and Quantum cost. These metrics of each kernel are calculated to analyze the performance of a kernel. These pixel values are convoluted with respect to different image kernels. MA TLAB tool is used for extracting the pixel values of a greyscale images and the Xilinx Vivado tool is for design implementation and functionality Verification.

articleTitle: Oil Spill Detection Using 2D Convolution Neural Network and Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Finding oil spills in the ocean is one of the most crucial tasks in preserving our ecosystem. Using satellite or aerial photographs as input to a deep learning model that makes use of 2D CNN (Convolution Neural Network) and GAN (Generative Adversarial Network). Deep learning assists in automatically detecting oil spills in the ocean. A strong model that may be applied to volumetric data is 2D CNN. To protect the environment and its biodiversity, it is critical to identify and minimize oil spills in delicate maritime environments. Conventional techniques for tracking oil spills in satellite imagery sometimes depend on labor-intensive, human error-prone manual inspection. When deep learning models are taught with a lot of data, they perform well. The Gathering of datasets, however the situation proved to be challenging. As a result, employing Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) to produce new photos by utilizing preexisting ones. As a result, by giving the model a suitable number of photos to use for training and testing, it improves accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Student Performance in Learning Online Courses using Ensemble Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Understanding and forecasting student performance has become essential for educators and administrators due to the widespread use of online learning platforms. This research study examines how well ensemble learning algorithms predict the performance of students enrolled in distance learning programs. Ensemble learning, which combines several base learners to increase generalization and prediction accuracy, presents a viable method for handling the challenging nature of student performance prediction problems. This research examines an ensemble learning method that analyses student data from online learning platforms using Hidden Markov Models (HMM) and XGBoost. The data gathered from multiple web sources was trained using the Decision Trees (DT) training technique. The comprehensive feature collection, comprising engagement metrics, demographic data, and past academic achievements, was obtained from student interactions through Ensemble feature extraction. The ensemble models use these features as inputs and are trained to predict student outcomes like retention, grades, and course completion. Through thorough testing and assessment of real-world datasets, it has been shown that ensemble learning successfully predicts student performance in various online courses and academic fields. When comparing the performance of ensemble models to conventional single-model methods, it is possible to see considerable gains in prediction resilience and accuracy. Lastly, the interpretability of ensemble models to learn more about the elements influencing how well students succeed in virtual learning environments. Several functional patterns and connections are identified that can guide intervention tactics, instructional design, and personalized learning experiences by examining feature importance and model explanations.

articleTitle: Advancing Brain Tumor Classification Using CNN and eXtreme Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study proposes an innovative hybrid approach for the identification of Brain Tumors (BT) with the help of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) image data, leveraging the integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with XGBoost Integration. Our architectural model begins with the input of MRI images, followed by a comprehensive CNN architecture featuring convolution layers, ReLU activation, max-pooling, and dense layers. Notably, the inclusion of XGBoost enhances the model's predictive capabilities through gradient boosting. The SoftMax activation layer concludes the architecture, providing a probability distribution for precise class predictions. This hybrid approach demonstrated superior accuracy, achieving 99%, compared to 96% accuracy without XGBoost. Furthermore, we introduced normalization and data augmentation in the intermediate layers, contributing to the robustness of our model. This integrated framework showcases the synergy between deep learning and boosting algorithms, offering a promising solution for accurate BT classification in MRI images.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Survey on Body Language Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Human Body language and expressions reveal a person's thoughts and emotions. Nonverbal cues provide insight into an individual's emotions. It describes the person's emotion, such as happiness or sadness. Detection techniques, such as instrumented sensor technology and computer vision, are well- established in research articles. Expressions can be classified based on the person's motion, whether still or moving. This research explores the use of Artificial Intelligence, Media-pipe, computer vision and other various technologies to detect people's emotions. The proposed model recognizes three emotions: joyful, sad, and victorious based on detected gestures. Difference in locations and detection from a distance may be challenging due to varying coordinates. This study provides a comprehensive review of Body Language Decoder.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Sustainable and Secure Operations of Cloud Data Centres for Optimising the Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study focuses on enhancing the sustainability and efficiency of hospital data centers through the deployment of machine learning algorithms. Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees (DT), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are applied to forecast server workloads and dynamically optimize resource allocation. SVM emerges as the most accurate model at 96.5%, leading a suite of models that effectively avoid server overloads and allow efficient load sharing. The research extends its influence to the optimization of important hardware parameters, including temperature, humidity, power consumption, and energy efficiency. Each approach contributes differently to enhance the performance of the server infrastructure reliability. The study continues with a thorough examination of energy efficiency gains over an 8-hour period, offering vital insights into the models' dynamic influence. Ultimately, this study develops a complete framework for sustainable and adaptable healthcare data management, revealing the potential of machine learning to modernize hospital infrastructure and meet increasing operational difficulties.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Medical Image Exchange Using Compressive Sensing and LSB Audio Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research introduces a new method for safe and simple medical image communication by combining compressive sensing with LSB (Least significant bit) audio steganography. The proposed approach guarantees the privacy of medical images during transfer, while also tackling the constraints posed by restricted bandwidth and storage capacity. This study utilizes the compressive sensing to compress images efficiently by employing random projections to minimize data size considerably. The medical images are compressed and then encoded with audio data using LS B steganography, providing a subtle and safe method for concealing information. The experimental findings show that the suggested technique is successful in accomplishing image compression and audio embedding without compromising data integrity. This study investigates the possibility of exchanging medical images with limited resources, demonstrating the feasibility and security of the proposed method. This study highlights the potential benefits of using compressive sensing with LSB audio steganography for safe and efficient medical image communication, particularly in telemedicine and healthcare systems.

articleTitle: DepthProbe: An Integrated Approach for Accurate Depth and Radius Estimation of Borewells
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The main theme of this work is to find out abandoned borewells in remote places so as to prevent people from falling into such a dreadful non-functional borewells accidentally and losing life. The abandoned borewells can be detected using OpenCV which is combined with other computer vision techniques to accurately detect the bore wells. Depth Probe is a technique used to measure the depth of a particular location, which are utilized in a wide range of applications across different industries. Borehole Depth Probe is used to measure the depth of a borewell. It is an innovative approach for accurate depth and radius estimation of Borewells even for satellite images. The system combines cutting-edge computer vision techniques to allow selection of regions of interest (ROI) for analysis. The proposed method effectively handles the challenges related to occlusions and varying lighting conditions, ensuring robust contour detection for accurate measurements. Extensive experiments on diverse images demonstrate the system's impressive performance in detecting multiple holes and providing precise measurements. This work showcases its potential for revolutionizing hole analysis across various locations. The research marks a significant advancement in automated hole detection and data-driven decision-making for sustainable resource management.

articleTitle: Development of Iot Enabled Air Pollution Detector Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Air pollution detectors are essential tools for understanding, mitigating, and controlling the air pollution, human health, and climate. Despite significant technological advances, developing fully reliable and widely applicable air pollution detectors remains a challenge. This study intends to develop a smart IOT device that will calculate the AQI value and by using machine learning approach, the proposed model can predict future outcomes. The experimental results of the proposed system are highly accurate in predicting the future outcomes when compared to other existing models.

articleTitle: Segmentation Approach: An Improved Solution for Solving Complex Mathematical Equations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Handwritten mathematical equation decoding and solving present major issues with far-reaching ramifications in the age of digital transformation and artificial intelligence. This research provides a novel method for the accurate recognition and effective solution of handwritten equations using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) coupled with Optical Character Recognition (OCR). The proposed system solves equations of different complexity with accuracy by using CNN -based classification, character segmentation, and picture pre-processing. When compared to traditional OCR models, experimental findings reveal gains in accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating the usefulness of the suggested technology. This work adds to the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in addition to improving the solution of handwritten equations. Through the use of character segmentation, CNN -based classification, and picture pre-processing, the system is able to solve equations with a wide range of complexity with impressive accuracy and speed. Experimental validation shows better performance than traditional OCR models, suggesting the method's efficacy in tackling the problems associated with solving handwritten equations. The results of this study offer promise for a number of fields needing precise and effective handwritten text processing, and they also advance artificial intelligence applications

articleTitle: A Deep Retrieval Model for Revit Software Database Based on Keyword Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study explores the implementation of a deep retrieval model for the Revit software database, harnessing the power of keyword mining algorithms to enhance the search functionality and efficiency. By extracting and categorizing relevant keywords from voluminous textual data, this research study can effectively organize and condense information, paving the way for seamless text mining and information retrieval efforts. This methodology results in a robust and reliable database that greatly simplifies the process of searching and retrieving relevant information. For the model under consideration, this study defines a dual-core network to capture the weighted contributions of two core nodes to each other within a local network. Specifically, the dual-core network consists of nodes 1 and 2, which share a common relationship, along with their neighboring nodes that connect them. The edge weights between these nodes are carefully assigned to accurately reflect the relevance of the connected nodes to the keyword query throughout the retrieval process. By updating these edge weights, this study can achieve an effective retrieval model. To rigorously assess the performance of our proposed algorithm, this study adopted a collaborative programming approach that combines the strengths of Python and MATLAB. The results indicate that our algorithm exhibits remarkable proficiency, with an average time consumption of 6.3 seconds and an impressive accuracy level of 0.990.

articleTitle: Optimising DOS Attacks Using Machine Learning Algorithms and Securing IOT Devices from Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In today's hyperconnected world, identifying and defending against denial-of-service (DoS) attacks and securing Internet of Things (IoT) devices are increasingly crucial. Recognizing distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks is essential for network security enhancement and IoT device security. This research explores various methods to mitigate the impact of DDoS attacks, aiming to reduce the likelihood of such attacks. We intend to employ machine learning strategies such as the Random Forest Algorithm, ADAboost, Blockchain, Gradient Boost, and Extra Tree Algorithm to prevent malicious network traffic from overloading servers and causing outages. The initiative offers significant advantages, particularly in theory and statistics. We will test our system using the NSL _ KDD dataset, initially training the data and then subjecting it to a series of tests. Data will be presented using tables, graphs.

Author Keywords: machine learning techniques for DoS/DDoS detection

articleTitle: Ear Recognition: Advancements and Trends in Biometric Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of biometric security, ear biometrics emerges as a promising and innovative approach, offering a unique advantage of contactless identification. This research paper aims to explore the potential of ear biometrics, a trait that stands out for its reliability, permanence, and the absence of physical contact required for enrollment. The study delves into the intricacies of ear detection and recognition, leveraging state-of-the-art deep learning models to analyze the unique characteristics of the ear that can be utilized for individual identification. The research is grounded in a comprehensive review of existing datasets, which are crucial for training and validating the models. The current challenges in ear biometric systems, such as the variability in ear anatomy and the impact of environmental factors on recognition accuracy, are identified. Despite these challenges, the future potential of ear biometrics is highlighted, emphasizing its role in enhancing security and convenience across various sectors, including healthcare, transportation, and personal identification. This research contributes to the ongoing discourse on the evolution of biometric technologies, advocating for the adoption of ear biometrics as a secure and efficient alternative to traditional password-based systems. By providing a detailed analysis of ear biometric methods, datasets, and the overcoming of current obstacles, the aim is to pave the way for future advancements in this field, ensuring that ear biometrics becomes a cornerstone of secure, user-friendly identification systems.

articleTitle: The Face Sync - Smart Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The existing attendance marking in various institutions, including schools and offices, is fraught with various challenges. Traditional methods, such as manual data collection through individual calls, are time-consuming and prone to errors. However, advancements in technology offer automated solutions that streamline the process and ensure accurate record-keeping. In this context, this study proposes the implementation of “The Face Sync-Smart Attendance Marking System, ” which leverages cutting-edge technologies for face identification and analysis. Developed using deep learning algorithms, this system effectively recognizes faces by analyzing gathered data. The recorded attendance data is then transmitted to the host via email for further processing. The proposed system is implemented using Python programming language and utilizes libraries such as CV2, Face Recognition, and Smtplib to achieve its functionality. This innovative approach promises to revolutionize attendance management, enhancing efficiency and reliability across various organizational settings.

articleTitle: Exploring Pre-Trained CNN Models for Classification of Melanoma
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Melanoma, the deadliest variety of skin cancer, requires early and precise detection for improved patient outcomes. This study investigates the success rate of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in classifying melanoma from dermoscopic pictures. Three pre-trained CNN architectures, Inception V3, MobileNet, and EfficientNetBO, were evaluated for their ability to distinguish melanoma from non-melanoma lesions. The openly accessible HAM10000 dataset was utilized, which comprised over 10, 000 dermoscopic images. Pre-processing procedures such as scaling, normalization, and data augmentation were applied to enhance data quality. Each CNN model was trained with the Adam optimizer, binary cross-entropy loss function, and early stopping to ensure optimal learning. The models were evaluated on a held-out test set, and their performance was tracked using accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score measures. EfficientNetBO showed the most accuracy of 91.1 %, 90.8% of precision, 91.4% of recall, and 91.1 % of Fl-score among the other pre-trained models. The research seeks to offer valuable insights into the potential of CNNs for reliable melanoma recognition, which could lead to improved medical decision-making and patient care.

articleTitle: The Versatility of Keyloggers: Data Retrieval and Covert Tracking Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: These days, data recovery is the most crucial component in many businesses. Thus, data recovery is crucial in many situations. The keylogger, also known as keyboard capture or keylogging, is one of the greatest solutions for these kinds of issues. The process of recording a keystroke on a keyboard such that the user is unaware that their actions are being watched is known as keyboard capture. Users can recover data when a working file is damaged for a variety of circumstances, such as power outages, by using the keylogger application. This is a surveillance program designed to monitor people who record keystrokes and extract data from log files. With the help of this program, we can remember lost emails or URLs. In this keylogger project, the user is unaware that, during the designated time frame, every keystroke they make on the keyboard is being recorded and emailed to the admin's email address.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review on Rumor Detection Techniques in Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Rumor detection is an essential task in the era of social media, where the spread of false information can cause significant harm to an individual, society, and institutions. The purpose of rumor detection is to promote transparency, accuracy, and trustworthiness in information sharing, thereby contributing to the well-being and stability of communities and society as a whole. The main objective of this study is to give a comprehensive review of the past literature on the rumor detection employing, methodologies through manual searches across five databases (IEEE Explore, Springer Link, Science Direct, ACM Digital Library, and Google Scholar), Our systematic review scrutinized these studies to address three formulated research questions, aiming to comprehensively grasp the prevailing trends in utilizing techniques for rumor detection and determine the most effective strategies, including machine learning, deep learning, network analysis, and linguistic analysis for detecting rumors in social media. This study provides an exhaustive list of datasets used for rumor detection and assesses significant studies based on the data sources and methodologies they utilize.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System for Internet of Thing Environment using Feature Engineering and Balanced Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Network intrusion detection is a crucial defensive mechanism against cyber threats, playing a vital role in preserving the integrity of organizational networks and safeguarding confidential data while averting financial and reputational damage. A prominent challenge in these systems is the significant imbalance between the voluminous normal samples and the relatively scarce malicious ones. To address this imbalance, this study introduces a hybrid sampling approach leveraging the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) to generate additional minority samples, thereby achieving a balanced dataset for model training. We have also used the feature importance concept for feature selection. The performance of the Balanced Random Forest (BRF) classifier, among other classification models, is thoroughly evaluated in this context. Moreover, the efficacy of the proposed model is benchmarked against the traditional SMOTE sampling methodology. When applied to the renowned CICIoT dataset, the RF classifier-equipped model demonstrated superior performance, achieving an impressive 91% accuracy and a 92% F1-Score, surpassing the results obtained with a DNN classifier.

articleTitle: Developing an AI-Driven Chatbot for Enhanced College Website Support Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: With the emerging technological revolutions, the higher education institutions are integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance their website support and user experience. A GPT-2-based chatbot has been developed to assist students, faculty, and stakeholders in navigating the college websites easily. The objective of this research study is to support college websites by interacting with user queries and predicting the cut-off mar of the students based on their academic performance. This AI-driven chatbot employs machine learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to address the inquiries regarding admissions, course details, academic resources, administrative procedures, and campus life. Utilizing deep learning techniques, the developed chatbot delivers comprehensive and contextually relevant responses, focusing on Q&A interactions. The chatbot, built upon the GPT -2 model by OpenAI, is skillful at generating human-like text and serves various applications, including customer support and information retrieval systems. Particularly, it specializes in predicting admission cut-off marks, employing regression models such as Linear Regression, Decision Tree Regressor, SVM Regressor, Random Forest Regressor, and XGBoost Regressor. These models consider various factors such as joining year, quotas, previous cut-off lists, department preferences, board exam difficulty, job market demands, and academic performance. The performance evaluation metrics like Mean Squared Error (MSE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and R-squared are utilized to assess the predictive accuracy of the proposed chatbot. By performing a thorough analysis of historical student data, the chatbot provides users with detailed answers and accurate forecasts regarding future academic performance, thereby enhancing the overall user experience of educational websites.

articleTitle: Brinjal Leaf Disease Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In India, Brinjal cultivation holds significant agricultural importance, yet plant leaf diseases pose a serious challenge to the sector. A timely and accurate prediction of these diseases could revolutionize early crop prevention and substantially mitigate economic losses. However, traditional methods of visually diagnosing plant diseases from leaf symptoms are increasingly prone to error, leading to ineffective treatments. As part of this study, a deep learning strategy is proposed to address this issue, leveraging Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) processing on a dataset of plant leaf images to identify Brinjal leaf diseases. This innovative approach promises to empower farmers with timely notifications, enabling prompt intervention to prevent the spread of disease over large areas and potentially increase crop yields.

articleTitle: NLP-Powered Data-Driven Career Decision Methodology Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: A chatbot application is intended to offer individualized career counseling. It examines the user's interests, educational history, and career objectives using sophisticated algorithms and machine learning. The app provides regular updates, tools, help with courses and exams, and individualized career insights. It also offers study guides and mock exams to help with exams. The user-friendly design of the chatbot makes navigating around it simple. Ongoing improvement is generated by system performance assessments and user input. By giving people the tools they need to make educated decisions about their educational and professional goals, the initiative seeks to transform career counseling.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Prediction for Home Appliances with Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Efficient energy management requires a thorough understanding of individual appliance energy consumption in both residential and business environments. Because of the growing number of Internet of Things (loT) devices in smart homes, household appliances are a significant source of total energy consumption. Commonly used equipment such as heating systems, washing machines, and vacuum cleaners have a substantial impact on daily energy consumption. Significant energy savings can only be realized by careful management and forecasting of these appliances' energy consumption. This research employs Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) models for energy forecasting of housing appliances, with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and a hybrid model known as Bi-LSTM-Attention Network. A Kaggle dataset with 28 features is used in this study, which is then reduced to 17 using a correlation plot. The processed data is used in both the training and testing phases of the RNN models. Many metrics are used to evaluate the performance of the models, including R-squared (R2), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). The Bi- LSTM-Attention Network achieves excellent performance, with training and testing R2 values of 0.9978 and 0.9835, respectively. In addition, lower MSE and RMSE values demonstrate that Bi-LSTM-Attention Network constantly outperforms LSTM. The findings show that the proposed Bi-LSTM-Attention Network is capable of accurately predicting the amount of energy household appliances will consume.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Elevated Learning Methodology on Student Performance Prediction: An Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study delves into the impact of Elevated Learning Methodology on student performance prediction through an empirical analysis utilizing Elevated Learning for Student Performance Prediction (ELSPP). The ELSPP model, implemented using Python, integrates advanced techniques such as AutoEncoder and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to augment the accuracy of the student performance prediction process. Leveraging a diverse dataset, the study demonstrates an accuracy of 97.75%, underscoring the effectiveness of the Elevated Learning (EL) approach in forecasting student outcomes. The Python implementation of the ELSPP model not only facilitates reproducibility but also enables educators and researchers to leverage and adapt the codebase for further exploration and refinement. The results support the adoption of sophisticated neural network architectures in educational analytics, offering a promising way for personalized learning interventions and the development of robust academic support systems.

Author Keywords: Elevated Learning for Student Performance Prediction (ELSPP)

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Management System using Background Subtraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The development of an intelligent and adaptive traffic signal management system lies in the challenges associated with urban traffic congestion and the need for efficient emergency vehicle passage. Urbanization and population growth have led to increased vehicular traffic, resulting in congestion during peak hours. An automated traffic monitoring system at the junctions with the count of the vehicles can help to achieve a dynamic allocation of timing for vehicles for achieving a smooth and congestion - free traffic movement. The proposed system can help in adjusting traffic signal timings based on the density of vehicles in each lane while prioritizing emergency vehicles. A common approach for vehicle detection is background subtraction. Background subtraction is a popular computer vision technique used to extract the foreground objects from a given video or image sequence. The main goal of this process is to differentiate the moving objects from a relatively static background. Detecting the approach of emergency vehicles can be done using RFID reader and tags. The primary goal of this system is to reduce traffic congestion by allocating time slots for each lane based on their current density, thereby optimizing overall traffic flow. Additionally, the system is designed to prioritize the passage of emergency vehicles, like ambulances, through intelligent detection mechanisms, ensuring swift and unobstructed access to critical locations.

Author Keywords: Radio Frequency Identification tags and readers

articleTitle: LungNet: Cascading Precision with ShuffleNet for Dynamic Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Respiratory process can be impaired by lung illnesses. For a long time, lung cancer was a major killer of people all over the globe. In the human race, the odds of survival are improved with early diagnosis. Early detection of lung cancer improves the median survival rate for patients from 16% to 52%. Even though CT (Computed Tomography) is far better than X-ray, a complete diagnosis still requires a battery of imaging tests that complement one another. In recent times, automated illness diagnosis has been greatly improved by deep learning algorithms, particularly CNNs. This work introduces a novel approach, the Cascading ShuffleNet Classification Model (CSCM), for lung cancer classification. It is cross-validated with the CNN algorithm to assess the model's efficiency. For the benefit of doctors and researchers in the area, this article will examine various models that result in varying degrees of sensitivity and accuracy when diagnosing early-stage lung cancer. Finding the problems with lung cancer using deep learning is the primary goal of this investigation. Using a deep learning model known as the Cascading ShuffleN et Classification Model, a new and promising method for learning features and identifying patterns based on LungNets has been developed. In order to detect lung cancer, we constructed a CSCM and a CNN model for this study. When comparing CSCM diagnosis to different artificial intelligence methods, we discovered that it is more often employed for lung-cancer therapy.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-Based Person Detection, Distance Monitoring, Speech Alerts, and Weapon Identification with Email Notifications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: An advanced security system utilizing the YOLOv8 algorithm for comprehensive object detection enables real-time identification of individuals and weapons. Innovative features include precise distance estimation and email alerts upon weapon detection, enhancing communication during security breaches. Rigorous testing ensures reliability, while ethical considerations ensure adherence to standards. This project represents a significant contribution to automated threat detection and response, exemplifying advancements in security technology within ethical boundaries, effectively addressing contemporary challenges. The integration of YOLOv8 for object, person, and weapon detection in audio, alongside distance estimation and email notification, marks a substantial leap in security surveillance technology, offering swift threat detection and coordinated response capabilities. Rigorous validation confirms its efficacy, promising to fortify security protocols and proactive threat mitigation strategies, thereby paving the way for further advancements in audio-based threat detection systems.

articleTitle: Smart Management System of Scientific Research Projects in Colleges based on Data Identification and Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The intelligent management system for university scientific research projects is designed to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of research through the use of data analysis and collaboration. The core innovation of the system is its ability to quickly and accurately identify data anomalies using a novel ant colony-based algorithm. This enables efficient identification and sharing of data among researchers, promoting a culture of openness and transparency in scientific research. The system also facilitates peer-to-peer information sharing, addressing three critical aspects of P2P sharing to ensure seamless collaboration and resource sharing. By fostering collaboration, the system leads to better research outcomes. The intelligent management system was implemented using the Struts2 framework, which separates concerns between the business logic controller and the servlet API, making it easier to maintain and modify. Experiments evaluating the system's data sharing performance showed a significant decrease in the average time required for nodes to share files as the number of nodes increased. This demonstrates the benefits of cooperative networking, where additional nodes contribute to available bandwidth resources and improve sharing efficiency.

articleTitle: SCIHYPO - A Deep Learning Framework for Data-Driven Scientific Hypothesis Generation from Extensive Literature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Scientific progress relies heavily on hypothesis generation, yet conventional methods often rely on expert intuition, limiting exploration of new ideas. To address this, we introduce SciHypo, a deep learning framework leveraging scientific literature to generate fresh hypotheses across diverse fields. SciHypo employs advanced natural language processing, including Generative Pre-trained Transformer to analyze patterns, relationships, and gaps in research. This allows the model to uncover latent connections and propose novel research trajectories. Filter search algorithms ensure the production of relevant hypotheses. A key strength is SciHypo's adaptability across scientific disciplines, enabling transdisciplinary hypothesis generation. Results demonstrate its ability to propose hypotheses resonating with experts, advancing scientific frontiers.

articleTitle: Generating Headlines from Article Summaries Using Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Generating headlines for articles requires a deep understanding of the article's content and context. Automating the process of generating titles for articles from their summaries can save significant time and effort for journalists and other content creators. The primary objective is to automate the process of generating titles for research papers or articles by using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and Machine Learning models. The study uses an open-source dataset from Kaggle with nearly 50000 records., each featuring titles., summaries., and terms. Various NLP techniques., such as tokenization and TF -IDF vectorization were employed to process and analyze the textual data. The proposed approach involves transfer learning based on pre-trained transformer architectures like BART and SimpleT5., as well as machine learning models., including SVM., K-Means., and Decision Trees. The result is successfully generated automatically with concise and informative titles that accurately represent the content of the article. Out of all the models proposed., BART has shown promising results with a minimal evaluation loss of 0.05.

articleTitle: Development of Cloud Orchestration for Optimizing Workflow with Resource Management Using Deep Learning with IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This study presents a progressive IoT framework for predictive protection and risk detection in corporate contexts, with a special focus on diesel generator applications. The device includes various sensors, inclusive of vibration, temperature, current, and fuel sensors, strategically positioned within the generator. These sensors continually grab real-time information, which is effortlessly delivered to the cloud for review. Notably, the gas sensor recognises toxic components within the exhaust gasoline, adding to danger detection. The study consists of machine learning to know models, consisting of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Decision Trees (DT), educated on historical and modern-day facts to are expecting probable hazards and maintenance needs. Performance reviews provide competing scores, which include accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 Score, displaying the usefulness of the offered trends. Confusion matrices give an in depth examination of proper positives, real negatives, false positives, and false negatives, offering insights about the models' class overall performance. Overall, the study shows that the suggested IoT device is both feasible and useful in boosting operational security, streamlining maintenance procedures, and encouraging a proactive approach to industrial workflow management. This research no longer most effective contributes to the evolution of IoT applications in predictive maintenance but additionally offers genuine consequences for companies seeking for to impose smart, information-pushed responses for progressive equipment health and general operational resilience.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique for Dermoscopy Image Processing Model for Early Melanoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The impact of melano ma has grown over the past three decades, making early detection more important for reducing mortality rates. In light of this, a dermoscopy image of a tumor and/or skin pigmentation coupled with an automatic, trustworthy system capable of detecting the presence of melanoma can be a powerful tool in the field of medical diagnostics. When it comes to cancer-related mortality, skin cancer consistently places near the top world wide. Fewer lives will be lost to skin cancer if it can be diagnosed and treated early. Automatic detection of skin lesions using dermoscopic photographs is still a tough and complicated task, despite the increased awareness of me lanoma and the medical community's efforts to develop a therapy. Using computers to evaluate images of skin lesions is crucial for early detection of skin cancer. Skin cancer has surpassed other forms of cancer as the most common cause of cancer death in people in recent years. Accurate melanoma diagnosis requires combining dermatological knowledge with computer vision techniques. To aid in the early diagnosis of melanoma, novel diagnostic techniques are urgently needed. Recent technological developments have enhanced a variety of computer-aided diagnostics for early detection of melanoma skin cancer. Four processes pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and classification are required for accurate melanoma diagnosis. This research presents a brief survey on melanoma image segmentation, feature extraction and selection and classification models. This research helps numerous research scholars, academicians to understand the working of available models and their limitations and to design innovative and accurate solutions for accurate melanoma detection.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Classification using Capsule Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: The most prevalent type of dementia is Alzheimer's disease, which impairs thinking, memory, and communication abilities. Better patient treatment is made possible with early disease identification. To detect and predict Alzheimer's disease through the analysis of Magnetic Resonance Images (MRIs), deep learning and big data analytics have recently been created. To improve the classification of Alzheimer's disease patients, this work utilizes capsule network. A critical evaluation is carried out on patients with Alzheimer's disease to improve stage-specific classification. Specifically, the study analyses various methods for performing abnormality identification in brain MRI images and pinpoint the shortcomings of those methods. Thus, it is possible to close the research gaps and enhance the shortcomings of different approaches to produce more accurate and superior results.

articleTitle: A Cloud-Based Approach to Secure Electronic Medical Records
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: In the domain of healthcare, ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of medical data is very important. This study proposes an innovative solution that utilizes blockchain technology within a cloud-based framework to address these critical issues. By dispersing and encrypting medical records, the proposed methodology enhances network security, fortifies data privacy, and Enhances confidentiality among healthcare stakeholders. The integration of blockchain not only mitigates network latency but also implements lightweight access controls, fostering the security infrastructure. Empirical findings highlight the efficacy of securely transmitting data through portable devices while upholding the sanctity of personal medical information. This approach holds the potential for advancing data security and privacy in healthcare environment, enabling trust and reliability between patients and providers. Incorporating blockchain technology paves way toward a more resilient and secure healthcare data ecosystem, ensuring the protection and confidentiality of sensitive medical information.

articleTitle: Turbine Lube Oil Monitoring and Analysis Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Lubrication oil is a crucial component in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of turbines. Its primary function is to provide lubrication and cooling to the intricate components within the turbine, thereby minimizing friction, reducing wear, and extending operational life. This abstract delves into the significance of lubrication oil properties for turbine applications, exploring the key properties that lubrication oil must possess, including viscosity, thermal stability, oxidation resistance, corrosion protection, foam control, demulsibility, and low volatility. These properties collectively contribute to maintaining optimal performance and safeguarding the longevity of turbines. This research study highlights the necessity of monitoring and maintaining these properties through sensors and regular analysis to ensure reliable turbine operation, enhanced energy efficiency, and reduced downtime. The study highlights the crucial role of lubrication oil properties in turbine functionality and emphasizes their pivotal role in maintaining the reliability of power generation systems.

articleTitle: Real- Time Image-based Calorie Estimation using YOLOv4 Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This research study presents an innovative approach to food calorie estimation using deep learning and computer vision techniques. With the growing concern over diet-related health issues, the system offers a convenient solution for individuals to assess the nutritional value of their meals using smartphones or desktop computers. Key components of the system include image acquisition, object detection, segmentation, volume estimation, and calorie estimation. Users capture photos of their meals with standard reference objects, which are then processed using object detection algorithms like YOLO- V 4 Darknet to identify and localize food items. The proposed and widely used YOLO algorithm for object detection operates by first grid-dividing the input picture and then using the grid cells to estimate the bounding boxes and class probabilities. Subsequent segmentation techniques isolate the food items from the background, followed by volume estimation using geometric formulas. Calorie estimation is performed based on the estimated volume and density of the food items using pre-defined tables. Experimental results demonstrate the system's accuracy in estimating calorie content, making it a valuable tool for individuals aiming to make informed dietary choices and maintain a healthy lifestyle.

articleTitle: Exploring Predictive Maintenance and Signal Processing Techniques for Automotive Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Predictive maintenance is one of the most crucial technologies in today's world, having applications in various domains like automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and so forth. It is a data-oriented approach that helps predict if any machine or associated component with the machine needs maintenance or not. It also helps predict the remaining lifespan of the same. Various machine learning-based algorithms and models are being developed in this domain. S ome of them include Deep-learning-based approaches like Autoencoders, ANN s, CNN s, and so forth, and Signal Processing models using factors like Mean Squared Error for superimposition of primary signals with appropriate opposite phase signals. This article presents a systematic study of various research works done in the fields specific to the Automotive sector. This study focuses on the problems solved by the authors through their proposed solutions, some of the results and insights, and a brief description of their proposed solution. Approximately 30 research papers were included selectively in this study. This study concludes by suggesting a future direction in the predictive maintenance field based on periodic monitoring, in contrast with the trend of continuous monitoring for early diagnosis.

articleTitle: Visualization and Analysis of Social Network-Based Diverse Datasets Using Multi-Viewpoint Similarity Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: This article focuses on visualizing and analyzing diverse datasets, with a specific emphasis on text data extracted from social networks such as Twitter, utilizing topic models with multi-viewpoint similarity metrics. Traditional topic modeling encounters challenges due to reliance on uncommon terms in tweets and manual selection of clustering parameters based on distance metrics. To address these limitations, this work employs hybrid topic models including Visual Latent Schematic Indexing (VLSI), Visual Probabilistic Latent Schematic Indexing (VPLSI), Visual Latent Dirichlet Allocation (VLDA), and Visual Non-negative Matrix Factorization (VNMF), alongside multi-viewpoint cosine-based similarity metrics (MVPs). Additionally, both Euclidean and Cosine-based measures are utilized in comparative clustering results obtained from the proposed model. Validation of results involves a combination of internal and external validity indices, memory usage, and execution time to assess the effectiveness of each method in revealing meaningful topics within the dataset. Through comprehensive analysis, this study offers valuable insights into the effectiveness of visual hybrid techniques, particularly when applied to diverse datasets sourced from social media platforms like Twitter.

articleTitle: Recognition and Identification of COVID-19 from Chest X-Rays for Earlier Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Early detection is critical for controlling the spread and death of the COVID-19 worldwide pandemic, which affects global health care and lifestyle. The gold standard diagnosis, Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) is both costly and has a lengthy process time. So more readily available and fast diagnostic methods are necessary. Many researchers proved that COVID-19 data can be effectively detected by Chest X-rays (CXR). However, diagnosing chest X-ray images for COVID-19 is difficult and error-prone. The only way to improve the COVID-19 diagnosis is to use DL algorithms. In this research, a novel deep learning model Convolutional Neural Network and Autoencoder (CNN-AE) tuned by Bat Optimization Algorithm (BOA) is proposed. The proposed approach would identify whether the CXR images were positive or negative for COVID. We received the CXR images from Kaggle. The pre-processing phases in the proposed technique assist with providing relevant information and reducing biased outputs. This is followed by the classification model. We were able to evaluate the performance of our proposed model by using Kaggle datasets. Our proposed model is evaluated using Kaggle datasets and achieved an average accuracy, True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), precision, F1-score, False Positive Rate (FPR), and False Negative Rate (FNR) of 99.28%, 99.42%, 99.14%, 99.42%, 99.28%, 0.85%, and 0.57% respectively. The outcome of the proposed method is compared with the existing and similar research. A comparative study shows that our proposed method outperforms the state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: Groundwater Quality Prediction using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Groundwater is a vital natural resource that sustains ecosystems and provides drinking water to a significant portion of the global population. An effective understanding of groundwater quality changes and its prediction is necessary for water resource management. This work integrates important chemical characteristics like pH, TDS, and others into a revolutionary deep-learning algorithm to forecast groundwater quality. This guarantees that under no circumstances will the results of the water quality examination be affected. We suggest a hybrid neural model that examines the dataset's parameter correlations for comprehensive and long-term feature extraction. This considerably aids in comprehending the parameter values, which are then integrated into a spatial-temporal neural network. The spatial-temporal factors also have a significant impact on the analysis. This study makes use of spatial-temporal neural networks, a subset of deep learning, to examine the intricate temporal and geographical correlations present in the dataset. To build an efficient dataset for model training, historical past groundwater quality data and the chosen environmental factors are gathered for pre-processing. This study shows the possibility of precise groundwater quality prediction, providing vital information for the management of water resources. By predicting the regions, where the groundwater quality is likely to decline, this study may be used practically to prevent pollution and guarantee a steady supply of safe water. Additionally, the combination of environmental data with deep learning establishes a standard for data-driven decision-making in the hydrogeology and water resource management fields, promoting the sustainable management of this critical natural resource.
